notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/0c58e139f257b4c5230a3b0c1f2a89e422cf0504.png[/img]

As the journey continues, you will join Hu Shanshan and the Nameless Wanderer, to unravel the secrets behind the ledger found at the Dragon Tiger Gate headquarters. This quest will take you deep into the heart of Loulan. Keep your wits about you, as you may find the journey more difficult than expected.

[h2]Blood of Iron: Chapter 7 Buff[/h2]
For the duration of this event, the following bonuses have been activated.
[list]
[*]Maximum Life increase by 25000
[*]Maximum Vital Energy increase by 15000
[*]10/1000 of Damage absorbed into Life
[*]10/1000 of Damage absorbed into Vital Energy
[*]Increases Exp gain by 20%
[/list]
The Blood of Iron: Chapter 7 Buff will last for 180 minutes. When the buff expires, you can relog in Hefei to receive the buff again.

notes.title: Blood of Iron: Chapter 6
notes.notes:
[code][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/55b9622e3af0895a63d4c88f508274ca4c5e8ed3.png"][/img]

After going dark for quite some time, Hu Shanshan finally returns from her mission. Having decrypted the cipher that was obtained from the Black Dragons Clan, she has sent out an urgent message. It seems the Black Dragon's reach has extended further than anticipated. In this chapter of the Blood of Iron Saga, Hu Shanshan is seeking your aid to help unravel the schemes of the Black Dragon Clan, before it's too late.

[h2]Blood of Iron - Chapter 6: Commemorative Gift[/h2]
In Commemoration of the Blood of Iron Chapter 6 you will be able to obtain the following items via the Event Window (H-Key).
[list]
[*]1x (New) 9Dragons Premium (30 Days)
[*]3x Warehouse Expansion (30 Days)
[*]1x [2025] Growth Support Box
[/list]

[h2]Blood of Iron: Chapter 6 Buff[/h2]
For the duration of this event, the following bonuses have been activated.
[list]
[*]Maximum Life increase by 25000
[*]Maximum Vital Energy increase by 15000
[*]10/1000 of Damage absorbed into Life
[*]10/1000 of Damage absorbed into Vital Energy
[*]Increases Exp gain by 20%
[/list]
The Blood of Iron: Chapter 6 Buff will last for 180 minutes. When the buff expires, you can relog in Hefei to receive the buff again.

[h2]Blood of Iron: Chapter 6 Event Quests[/h2]
Upon decrypting the cipher, Hu Shanshan unveils that a Black Dragons Clan spy within the League of Beggars Clan, and most likely the other clans as well. Assist Hu Shanshan by identifying the spy within your own clan and follow their trail of corruption to its source. In this chapter, each clan will have their own questline, including Vagabonds.

[i]Road to Karma Quest: [Blood of Iron] Qingdao Truth 1~4[/i]
NPC: Hu Shanshan (Kunlun)
Condition: Lvl 91+, Windgram
Reward: Flawless Silver Outfit (M/F)

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/a77fac23bb47f13c505e6b0eb7d0b7a8ae2a12f2.png"][/img]

[i]Heroic Quest: [i][Blood of Iron] Dragon Tiger Gate Invitation (Daily)[/i][/i]
NPC: Dragon Tiger Gate Recruiter Hwang Chimyeong (Qingdao)
Condition: Lvl 91+, Windgram
Reward: Dragon Tiger Gate Invitation (3)

[i]Heroic Quest: [Blood of Iron] Dragon Tiger Gate's Pursuit (Daily)[/i]
NPC: Clan Investigation Leader (Qingdao)
Condition: Lvl 91+, Windgram
Reward: Camouflage Cloth Pouch (3)

[h2]Followers of the Dragon Tiger Gate Clan[/h2]
The followers of the Dragon Tiger Gate Clan do not take too kindly to outsiders snooping around their establishment. Defeat these followers for a chance to obtain a Dragon Tiger Gate Badge that can be collected and exchanged for items at NPC Seo Hwarang.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/0d9e99536df5fa35248088f19433620b903c6f15.png"][/img]

[h2]Dragon Tiger Gate Dungeon[/h2]
Follow the trail of the Black Dragons Clan spy to the Dragon Tiger Gate.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/56f3d0438f2028b8338650212bccc91650686678.png"][/img]

The Dragon Tiger Gate Dungeon is located in Qingdao at coordinates (106,572)

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/4b9d9940096802e85846318f58d619aaeb2012eb.png"][/img]

Entering this dungeon will require 3x Dragon Tiger Gate Invitation, which can be obtained via Daily Quest, after completing the Qingdao Truth Questline.

[b]Reward: Dragon Tiger Secret Pouch[/b]

[i]The Dragon Tiger Secret Pouch contains 2 or more of the following items.[/i]
[list]
[*]Sealed Bead (Excellence) (10) (100%)
[*]Option Switch Rune (10) (100%)
[*]Wooden Black Dragon Plate (2)
[*]Black Dragons Luggage (2)
[*][Iron Blood] Blood Essence Box
[*]Sapphire Stone Shard (2)
[*]Soul Stone (2)
[*][Iron Blood] Clan Dungeon Resource Box
[/list]

[h2]Pursuit Into the Night Dungeon[/h2]
After infiltrating the Dragon Tiger Gate, the Black Dragon Clan won't just let you escape. Desperately navigate through the treacherous back alleys of Qingdao to flee from their clutches, so you can relay what you've uncovered to your Clan Leader.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/a1cfddebf4b7d59ad95d76506d3a7773a567fdfc.png"][/img]

The Pursuit Into the Night Dungeon is located in Qingdao at coordinates (465,665)

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/966da63bd70682708b482ad9c7288ffb68d8975c.png"][/img]

notes.title: Kowloon Memorial
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/be1e24f86b2b5d57ced30a4d213ef4f61d54bde3.png[/img]

A Memorial is being held in Hefei to honor the souls of those who lost their lives in the War of the Nine Dragons. Warriors of all clans are welcome to pay their respects. As there was once a great turmoil between the black and the white clans, one can only hope a gathering such as this would be a peaceful one. In this event, you will have a chance to obtain new exclusive event items, and valuable in-game materials.

[h2]Welcome Gift for New Heroes[/h2]
For the duration of this event, you will be able to obtain the following items via the Event Window (H-Key).
[list]
[*]Heaven's Guard Weapon Exchange ticket
[*]Heaven's Guard Spirit Exchange Ticket
[*]National Hero Badge
[/list]

[h2]Kowloon Memorial Ceremony Buff[/h2]
In honor of those who lost their lives, the following buffs have been activated.
[list]
[*]Maximum Life increase by 25000
[*]Maximum Vital Energy increase by 15000
[*]10/1000 of Damage absorbed into Life
[*]10/1000 of Damage absorbed into Vital Energy
[*]Increases Exp gain by 20%
[/list]
The Kowloon Memorial Ceremony Buff will last for 180 minutes. When the buff expires, you can relog in Hefei to receive the buff again.

[h2]Kowloon Memorial Event Quests[/h2]

[i]Road to Karma Quest: [event] Kowloon Memorial Ceremony 1~3[/i]
NPC: Wan Daye (Hefei)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/b92ad3d424b0d74f2fbed2eb5466e55cef15c2be.png[/img]
Every year in Qingdao, a festival is held to honor the spirits of the dead. People from all across The Land show up dressed in costumes of ghouls and ghosts to imbibe and dance until the sun comes up. This year, there have been reports of residents disappearing, and our heroes have been called forth to investigate this occurrence. Uncover the mystery and you will be rewarded greatly, however, you might be in for more than you bargained for.

[h2]Ghost Festival Buff[/h2]
In celebration of the spirits of the dead, the following buffs have been activated.
[list]
[*]Maximum Life increase by 25000
[*]Maximum Vital Energy increase by 15000
[*]10/1000 of Damage absorbed into Life
[*]10/1000 of Damage absorbed into Vital Energy
[*]Increases Exp Gain by 20%
[/list]
The Ghost Festival Buff will last for 180 minutes. When the buff expires, you can relog to receive the buff again.

notes.title: Altar of the Forgotten God
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/9528613e08105b803b46489fba1350c67e20f8dc.jpg[/img]

In the war between Kunlun Immortal Sages and the Blood Sorcerers, a secret plan to perform a ritual to seize the power of a long forgotten deity has been unveiled. While the threat of using the corrupted god's energy to achieve immense destructive power looms over the land, Kunlun's Sages have called out to any brave warrior willing to face it.  Answer the call and you will be in the favor of the Kunlun Sages.

[h2]Altar of the Forgotten God Buff[/h2]
With the blessing of the Kunlun Sages, the following buffs have been activated.
[list]
[*]Maximum Life increase by 25000
[*]Maximum Vital Energy increase by 15000
[*]10/1000 of Damage absorbed into Vital Energy
[*]Increases Exp gain by 20%
[/list]
The Altar of the Forgotten God Buff will last for 180 minutes. When the buff expires, you can relog to receive the buff again.

[h2]Altar of the Forgotten God Event Quests[/h2]
Seeking those who do not immortal energy to fight, the Kunlun Sages have sent out requests to vanquish those that would abuse the might of the corrupted god's energy.

[i]Heroic Quest: [event] Forgotten God's Altar (Daily)[/i]
NPC: N/A
Condition: Lvl 91+, Accept Windgram
Reward: Records of the Kunlun Immortals (3)

[i]Heroic Quest: [event] Forgotten God's Altar (Weekly)[/i]
NPC: N/A
Condition: Lvl 91+, Accept Windgram
Reward: Records of the Kunlun Immortals (Extreme) (3)

[b]Altar of the Forgotten God Event Dungeon[/b]
The only way to stop the corruption of the forgotten deity's destructive power is to halt the ritual that is to take place at the dungeon's altar. One of Kunlun's Merchant Marines awaits any warrior willing to travel to the Forgotten God's Altar.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/b0fbd940ae60aca9f8e01c9f9422618645d70d97.png[/img]

The Altar of the Forgotten God Dungeon Entrance can be found in the center of Herb Village in Hefei at the coordinates (857,105)

notes.title: Ghost Ship of the Abyss
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/ac89c705edd70d4c68f1a5972aa64d18ad3bf75e.jpg[/img]

An ominous fog has swept across The Land, bringing with it a ghastly ship and a crew of undead pirates. Although their intentions are unclear, one thing for certain is that they leave nothing but chaos and destruction in their wake. Heroes have been called from the farthest reaches in order to eliminate the threat where others could not. Defeat them and you may just uncover the riches they have plundered over the centuries.

[h2]Ghost Ship of the Abyss Buff[/h2]
In the shroud of the ominous fog, the following bonuses have been activated
[list]
[*]Maximum Life increases by 25000
[*]Maximum Vital Energy increases by 15000
[*]10/1000 of Damage absorbed into Life
[*]10/1000 of Damage absorbed into Vital Energy
[*]Increases EXP gain by 20%
[/list]
The Ghost Ship of the Abyss buff will last for 180 minutes. When the buff expires you can relog to receive the buff again.

[h2]Ghost Ship of the Abyss Event Quests[/h2]
A mysterious ship shrouded in fog has appeared in Liaodong. Although many have been sent to investigate, few have returned. As such, bounties have been placed to eliminate the ghostly threats that loom over the land. Although the bounties are rich, you may be in for more than you bargained for.

[i]Road to Karma Quest: [event] Ghost Ship of the Abyss (Daily)[/i]
NPC: N/A
Condition: Lvl 90+  Accept Windgram
Reward: Navigation Compass (3)

[i]Road to Karma Quest: Demons and Monsters (Weekly) (Black Clan)[/i]
NPC: He yu Shenping (Fengwei Village)
Condition: Lvl 90+ Accept Windgram, Collect 20x Blue Spirit Stone Fragment and 20x Red Spirit Stone Fragment
Reward: Hefei Golden Flag

[i]Road to Karma Quest: Demons and Monsters (Weekly) (White Clan)[/i]
NPC: Sun Yashan (Fengtou Village)
Condition: Lvl 90+ Accept Windgram, Collect 20x Blue Spirit Stone Fragment and 20x Red Spirit Stone Fragment
Reward: Hefei Golden Flag

[h2]Ghost Ship of the Abyss Field Event[/h2]
With the arrival of the ghost ship in the harbor, ominous spirits have infested the lands of Liaodong. It is up to you to help these lost wandering spirits rest in peace. During the duration of the event, [event] Blue Will-o-Wisp, and [event] Red Will-o-Wisp will be spawned throughout Liaodong. The [event] Blue Will-o-Wisp can transform into a Goblin Spirit, and [event] Red Will-o-Wisp can turn into a Jiangshi Spirit.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/fd7e67a1eabb7c433290db20ed456556c94a8959.jpg[/img]

Upon defeating these monsters, there is a chance they will drop a Faint Spirit Fragment.

[h2]Ghost Ship of the Abyss Event Dungeon[/h2]
A team of navigators were sent to investigate the mysterious ship, but only one returned with his life, bearing a magical navigation compass that points the user directly to the ship. It is up to the warriors of the land to take this compass and bring an end to the terror haunting the land

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/a51fb2c4213cdd885ac1206ad5d891584e09507b.png[/img]

The Ghost Ship of the Abyss Dungeon can be entered at the coordinates (497,192)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/dafe80e632d8945a4d480616e6b345ecfd273a50.png[/img]

[b]Ghost Ship of the Abyss Normal[/b]
Entering this dungeon will require 3x Navigation Compass, which can be obtained via daily quest.

[*]Option Add Rune
[/list]


[b]Ghost Ship of the Abyss (True)[/b]

notes.title: Ancient Ruins
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/64a34618b763ff1f2c10ff0d810fd131bb9ceb94.jpg[/img]

Ancient ancestral ruins have been unearthed in the depths of Kunlun. The mystery and wonder of this sacred site is not without its perils extending across The Land. Investigate these ruins and the disaster it spreads, for a chance to obtain great fortune and fame!

[h2]Ancient Ruins Buff[/h2]
With the opening of the Ancient Ruins Chambers an aura was released across The Land, granting the following bonuses.
[list]
[*]Maximum Life increases by 25000
[*]Maximum Vital Energy increases by 15000
[*]10/1000 of Damage Absorbed into Life
[*]10/1000 of Damage absorbed into Vital Energy
[*]Increases Exp gain by 20%
[/list]
The Ancient Ruins Buff will last for 180 minutes. When the buff expires, you can relog to receive the buff again.

[h2]Ancient Ruins Event Quest[/h2]
According to the rumors of one nameless wanderer, Ancient Ruins have been discovered in the pit of Loulan. Rumor has it that none who have dared to enter have returned. Will you claim the fortune that awaits or become another statistic?

[i]Road to Karma Quest: [event] Ancient Ruins (Daily)[/i]
NPC: N/A
Condition: Accept windgram
Reward: Nameless Wanderer's Request Tablet (3)

[h2]Kunlun's Filial Son Event Quest[/h2]
Due to the excavation of the Ancient Ruins, a rock slide has occurred in Kunlun, causing Hwang-Sik to be halted from returning home to his mother. There is a detour, but perilous white tigers infest the path. Help this loyal citizen return to his mother.

[i]Road to Karma Quest: Hunting White Tiger from Kunlun Mountain (Daily)[/i]
NPC: Festival Trainee Baekhwa (Hefei)
Condition: Accept Quest
Reward: Hwang-Sik's Request Letter (3)

[h2]Ancient Ruins and Kunlun Mountain Event Dungeons[/h2]
Should you decide to brave the ancient ruins of Loulan you will be met with great peril, for if you get past the raiders who seek to claim its riches, you will then have to face the guardians that protect its sacred grounds. If you can come back alive, you will surely reap the fame and fortune of your discoveries.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/4685686f6cd6bb331e707cb76772be801b0010fa.jpg[/img]

The Ancient Ruins Dungeon can be entered at the coordinates (477,450) in the circled area in the map below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/f21923d1bfc4a7d40bf7f67fbd9620cc3e8a510b.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/79ac9d67ef23b19a4ec03ce6f33ab1673aa10025.jpg[/img]

[b]Ancient Ruins Dungeon[/b]
Entering this dungeon will require 3x Nameless Wanderer's Request Tablet, which can be obtained via daily quest.

[i]Reward: Ancient Artifact Box[/i]

[i]Ancient Artifact Box Contains 2 or more of the following items.[/i]
[list]
[*]Unknown Artifact (5) (100%)
[*]Sealed Bead (Large) (5) (100%)
[*]Bead of Storm (3)
[*]Option Switch Rune (5)
[*]Option Add Rune
[/list]

[b]Ancient Ruins Dungeon (True)[/b]
Entering this dungeon will require 3x Nameless Wanderer's Request Tablet (True), which can be obtained through Seo Hwarang's Resource List

[i]Reward: Ancient Artifact Box (True)[/i]

[i]Ancient Artifact Box (True) contains 2 or more of the following items.[/i]
[list]
[*]Unknown Artifact (10) (100%)
[*]Sealed Bead (Excellence) (5) (100%)
[*]Bead of Storm(Gold) (3)
[*]Option Switch Rune (10)
[*]Wave Healing Stone
[*]Seal of Yellow Dragon (2)
[/list]

After the excavation of the Ancient Ruins, tremors across the land caused a rock-slide in Kunlun, leaving Hwang-Sik, Watchman of Herb Village, stranded from his mother. There is a detour through the mountains, however, as another effect of the rock-slide, an abnormally large ambush of tigers have migrated, blocking the path. Should you help clear the path and return Hwang-Sik to his family, the spoils of the endeavor will be yours.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/e34d0d2602f0422f6d8ed7ff6fea86825fd88fb9.jpg[/img]

The Kunlun Mountains Dungeon can be entered at the coordinates (853,134) in the circled area in the map below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/b6c77491b5292fa0562949897da8a4159de60fa0.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/3435880c4523f0f734af3591da40a52bdef54221.jpg[/img]

[b]Kunlun Mountain Dungeon[/b]
Entering this dungeon will require 3x Hwang-Sik's Request Letter, which can be obtained via daily quest.

[b]Kunlun Mountain Dungeon (True)[/b]
Entering this dungeon will require 3x Hwang-Sik's Special Request Letter, which can be obtained through Seo Hwarang's Resource List

The disturbance of the Ancient Ruins released the previously contained danger upon Loulan's grounds. Now the guardians of the chambers run free seeking vengeance on any who cross their path for awakening them from their slumber. Defeat them in Loulan before they can wreak their havoc across the land.

notes.title: 8th Anniversary Celebration
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/96ad25995f4582a98c6a62a5b2f45fe324a36569.jpg[/img]

It's that time of the year! Log in and celebrate the 9Dragons 8th Anniversary Celebration! To show our thanks and appreciation to all those who joined us on this journey, we are happy to host an extravaganza of an event to participate in for a chance to earn some great items, including event exclusive costumes, relics, and more!

[h2]A Special Gift to Celebrate the 8th Anniversary[/h2]
What better way to start the 8th Anniversary Celebration than with a free 8th Anniversary Gift Box by simply logging into game! You can claim this gift by clicking on the gift box icon or pressing the (H) key. (The 8th Anniversary Gift Box can be claimed once per account during the event duration)

[i]The 8th Anniversary Gift Box contains the following items.[/i]
[list]
[*]Hanbok Costume (30 Days) Exchange Ticket
[*]Bead of Storm (Gold) (10)
[*]Sealed Bead (Large) (10)
[*]Guardian Spirit Box (Rank 3~5)
[*]Kunlun Immortal Token (Hard)
[*]8th Anniversary Trinket Box
[list]
[*]8th Anniversary Ring 1
[*]8th Anniversary Ring 2
[*]8th Anniversary Necklace 1
[*]8th Anniversary Necklace 2
[*]Sealed Red Earrings 1
[*]Sealed Red Earrings 2
[/list]
[/list]

[h2]8th Anniversary Buff[/h2]
In celebration of our 8th anniversary, we're activating the following bonuses, which will run for the event period's duration.
[list]
[*]Maximum Life increases by 25000
[*]Maximum Vital Energy increase by 15000
[*]10/1000 of Damage absorbed into Life
[*]10/1000 of Damage absorbed into Vital Energy
[*]Increases Exp gain by 20%
[/list]
The 8th Anniversary Event Buff will last for 180 minutes. When the buff expires, you can relog to receive the buff again.

[h2]Event Mini Bell[/h2]
During the duration of the event, [event] Mini Bells will spawn across the land dropping Broken Black Dragon Coins which can be traded in via resource to Baekhwa for an assortment of consumable items and event materials.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/2f0265905fd39c4ee484ae1e7082a1406ffeadb1.jpg[/img]

The [event] Mini Bell can be found at the following locations.
Normal: Loulan, North Sea, Tibet
Hard: Kunlun, Qingdao

[h2]8th Anniversary Event Quests[/h2]
Celebrate the 8th anniversary with the following quests!

[i]Heroic Quest (Daily): 8th Anniversary Bamboo Village Treasure Hunt[/i]
NPC: Festival Trainee Baekhwa (Hefei)
Condition: Lvl 90+ Talk to Baekhwa
Reward: Bell Fragment (3)

[i]Heroic Quest (Weekly): [event] Blue Dragon Awakening Ceremony[/i]
NPC: Accept via Windgram
Condition: Lvl 90+
Reward: Kunlun Immortal Token (Normal) (3)
Note: Can exchange for Kunlun Immortal Token (Hard) via Seo Hwarang Resource.

[i]Heroic Quest (Weekly): [event] Defeat the Infinite Dungeon Invaders (Weekly)[/i]
NPC: Recluse Master The Nameless Wanderer
Condition: LVL 90+ Defeat Infinite Dungeon Evils on Stage 10
Rewards: 8th Anniversary Special Coin, Infinite Stone [reward] (7), Spirit of Challenge [reward] (7)

[h2]8th Anniversary Dungeon[/h2]
The bandits of Bamboo Village have stolen the anniversary Celebration Bell, and it is up to you to defeat them and ring the bell!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/c7cf06f40a1a0de45e4988595b5d29bd4014307e.jpg[/img]

The 8th Anniversary Dungeon can be entered at coordinates (126,140) in the area circled in the map below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/106928b235fb315da45235be25a1ad8a7d2a0276.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/3acef5f94056ca4f4c07daaa83707d909ca08eb9.jpg[/img]

[b]8th Anniversary Dungeon (Normal)[/b]
Entering this dungeon will require 3x Bell Fragment which can be obtained daily via Baekhwa's Event Quest, or via Bell Fragment Box in Seo Hwarang's Resource List.

[h2]Blue Dragon Dungeon[/h2]
The Year of the Dragon is the time when the power of the infamous Blue Dragon is at it's peak. In this time of opportune, the heroes of the land are preparing a ritual to harness this power to aid in the fight against the blood sorcerer bloodline. These heroes will need your help to defend them until the ritual is complete!

notes.title: Blood of Iron: Chapter 2
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/80992669ef452d6e548ca11a35a860a1653c29b6.png[/img]

In this second installment of the Blood of Iron saga, we rejoin Gong Jiamu and Yiqian Li in their journey through the North Sea. Unravel the mysteries of their quest to the North Sea and the secrets behind the Icy Palace. While under the constant pursuit of the Black Dragons Clan, the task is fraught with peril. But with great risks comes even greater rewards.

[h2]Blood of Iron Buff[/h2]
Continue your journey into the North Sea with the Blood of Iron buff. The following bonuses will run for the event period's duration.
[list]
[*]Maximum Life/Vital Energy increase by 10000
[*]10/1000 of Damage absorbed into Life
[*]10/1000 of Damage absorbed into Vital Energy
[*]Increases Exp gain by 20%
[/list]
The Blood of Iron Buff lasts for 180 minutes. Once it expires, you can relog to receive it again.


[h2]Blood of Iron: Chapter 2 Questline[/h2]
Upon finishing the Blood of Iron: Chapter 1 quest line, Wan Daye will contact you to meet with Gong Jiamu and Yiqian Li after their arrival in the North Sea. Following their lead, with the aid of the North Sea citizens, it is your task to investigate the newly controlled Icy Palace, and the secrets hidden behind its well fortified walls. Through this journey, you will find that violence is not always the answer, and sometimes you could use a helping hand in a dire situation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/be305bc6fa56d47e3cd06b26ea48689e916a6ceb.jpg[/img]

Upon completing this quest line, you will be rewarded with a Peerless Under Heaven (30 Days) Epithet Scroll for your efforts.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/f8a5ef89d19f1921ba9fd8af5971c425fdc4e599.png[/img]


[h2]Blood of Iron: Chapter 2 Weekly Quest[/h2]
After you have completed the Road to Karma Blood of Iron: Ch 2 Quest Line, you will be able to accept the Heroic Reinvestigation of the North Sea Icy Palace (Weekly) Quest from the Third Princess of North Sea, Snowland, to obtain Intricate Icy Palace Secret Keys to enter the True Icy Palace Secret Passage Dungeon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/3c8ae45a1482383054fff34e802db791079f10b1.jpg[/img]


[h2]Intricate Icy Palace Secret Key Dungeon[/h2]
With the passes obtained from the weekly quest, you will be able to enter the true version of the Icy Palace Secret Passage Dungeon. Upon completion of this dungeon, you will receive relics, consumables, and valuable materials, some of which can be used to create event items, that are only available for a limited time.

[i]Rewards:[/i]
[list]
[*]Black Dragon North Sea Area: Faded Pure Ice Fragment Box
[*]Black Dragon North Sea Area: Support Box
[*]Black Dragon North Sea Area: Accessory Box
[/list]

[i]Black Dragon North Sea Area: Faded Ice Essence Box contains one of the following items.[/i]
[list]
[*]Faded Ice Essence (1~30)
[/list]

[i]Black Dragon North Sea Area: Support Box contains one of the following items.[/i]
[list]
[*]Yellow Dragon Jade
[*]Mystic Silk

[*]Huatuo's Panacea
[*]Option Switch Rune
[*]Option Add Rune
[/list]

[i]Black Dragon North Sea Area: Accessory Box contains one of the following items.[/i]
[list]
[*]Black Dragon Orb
[*]Black Dragon Scale Bracelet
[*]North Sea Ice Essence
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/c7d1452bd17eeaeaf694dec3b6d7b94b7203bb2d.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/b18159dd1f26bd6f3785c1476049d178f6c98671.png[/img]

The Icy Palace Secret Treasure Key allows you to enter a special dungeon where you can obtain valuable items with little effort. After entering the dungeon, you only need to open the treasure chest to obtain the reward items, and escape the dungeon.

notes.title: Mysterious Island
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/9863b138455fbf82f089e55bfdc46d81a1a5c1a6.png[/img]

Off of the southern region of Liaodong, a Mysterious island has been unveiled. Undisturbed for over a millennia, this island is riddled with the power of the Four Shenshou, aka the Four Guardian Deities. Drawn by this divine power, the evil known as Fu-Nanchoo has extended his hand to corrupt the Shenshou to do his bidding. Rid this land of his grasp and purify the guardians, and you just might claim their power as your own in the process. In this event, you can participate in event dungeons and quests for a chance to create some powerful relics, ornaments, and costumes imbued with the energy of the four guardian deities.

[h2]Summer Buff[/h2]
Embrace the power of the sun with the Summer Buff. The following bonuses will run for the event period's duration.
[list]
[*]All Resistance increases by 999
[*]Critical Defense increases by 700%
[/list]
The Summer Buff lasts for 180 minutes. Once it expires, you can relog to receive it again.

[h2]Mysterious Island Event Quests[/h2]
Suffering the wrath of the corrupted Shenshou, it is of great urgency to purify the island and bring peace to all the land. As such, quests have been put out to do just that. See Festival Trainees Baekhwa and Jeoksam in Hefei to accept these quests.

Heroic Quest (Daily): To the Mysterious Island
NPC: Festival Trainee Baekhwa (Hefei)
Condition: Lv 150+
Reward: Smuggler Secret Ticket (3)

Heroic Quest (Daily): The Wherabouts of the Corrupted Four Guardians
NPC: Festival Trainee Jeoksam (Hefei)
Condition: Lv 150+ Kill [Corruption Shenshou] Blue Dragon
Reward: Proof of Corrupted Defeated Shenshou

[h2]Mysterious Island Dungeon[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/fb6b6ac636542481a4fda5e463c19d10dcf235a1.png[/img]

Follow Fu-Nanchoo's trail of corruption to the source of the Four Guardian's power in the Mysterious Island Dungeon. In order to purify the island, you will not only need to rid it of Fu-Nanchoo's grasp, but also defeat the corrupted Shenshou to bring them back to their senses as guardians. To reach this island, you will need to take a smuggler's boat docked by the Shool of Rising Sun in Liadong. It will cost 3x Smuggler Secret Tickets to enter the dungeon which can be obtained via Baekhwa's event quest, or by resourcing [event] Smuggler's Secret Box through The NPC Seo Hwarang.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/3fd25636b95e4ce5411612251007ebb2b164abeb.png[/img]

The Mysterious Island Dungeon entrance can be found in Liaodong at coordinates 495,190.

[i]Mysterious Island Drops:[/i]
[list]
[*]Korean Ginseng
[*]Option Switch Rune
[*]Option Add Rune
[*]Sealed Bead
[*]Sealed Bead (Medium)
[*]Sealed Bead (Excellence)
[*]Cloudy Gem Fragment
[*]Unstable Shenshou Aura
[*]Essence of the Corrupted Shenshou
[*]Triple Groove Cutter
[*]Stable Shenshou Aura
[*]Everlasting Shenshou Aura
[*]Horn of the Corrupted Shenshou
[*]Corrupt Shenshou Charm
[*]Corrupt Shenshou Spirit
[*][Event] X15 Exp Bonus Card
[*]Tender Stone (Excellence)
[*]Double Groove Cutter (Hermit)
[*]Fur of the Corrupted Shenshou
[*]Scale of the Corrupted Shenshou

With the arrival of the Clan Dungeon Update, comes the latest edition to our summer celebration! During this time, you can earn additional Clan Dungeon party rewards through completing the dungeons and completing limited time event quests, to help give you a head start on the new content. In addition, a special event dungeon as well as bonus raid rewards for East and West Temple has been added in order to obtain event exclusive relics, costumes, and epithets. As icing on the cake, you can receive a relic set as a one time gift per account, simply for logging in!

[h2]Summer Buff[/h2]
Celebrate the arrival of the Wet Hot Summer Event with the Summer Buff. The following bonuses will run for the event period's duration.

notes.title: Clan Dungeon 2nd Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/577c9b0fae32745a39837055ad3ecbc58125db56.png[/img]

As the Black Dragons Clan rises in power, they extend their control deeper into the land. The Shaolin and Sacred Flower clans, originally thought to be impenetrable, have been compromised. As this threat extends beyond individual clans, a temporary alliance has been made, to make all clan dungeons available to any willing to take on the Black Dragons. In this update, we are introducing two new raid format dungeons for both the Shaolin and Sacred Flower, you can participate in to obtain materials to create a new set of powerful relics, in addition to the armor sets and clan skills already available.

Access the dungeon solo or party with four players to defeat fearsome monsters and obtain top-tier equipment.

[list]
[*]Level Requirement: 230+
[*]Solo or four players parties can enter the dungeon.
[*]You can choose between Normal and Hard (True) dungeons.
[*]Each dungeon can be entered once per day, for a total of 4 entries. (Solo: Normal/True, Party: Normal/True)
[*]Create New Equipment.
[/list]

[h2]New Clan Dungeon Entrances[/h2]
To ensure that every clan dungeon can be accessed by any clan, the dungeon entrances have been move to the Highlands of Bamboo Village.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/83533765cbf023e26d7503dd41733112066e752e.png[/img]

[b]Wu-Tang Dungeon[/b]
Enter the Wu-Tang Dungeon by clicking the Blue Statue. Enter the True Wu-Tang Dungeon by clicking the Red Statue.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/b82fcd0a1857e3ce28db3316ecbefc825c4e8f37.png[/img]

Defeat all deviants, including one Sub-Boss and one Final Boss. The door leading into the Final Boss stage will not open until all deviants are defeated.

[b]Heavenly Demon Dungeon[/b]
Enter Heavenly Demon Dungeon by clicking the Blue Statue. Enter True Heavenly Demon Dungeon by clicking the Red Statue.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/c6b9fcd59fabc8531b83966844a39461cc0b17bf.png[/img]

Defeat all deviants, including one Sub-Boss and one Final Boss. The door leading into the Final Boss stage will not open until all deviants are defeated.

[b]Shaolin Dungeon[/b]
Enter the Shaolin Dungeon by clicking the Blue Statue. Enter the True Shaolin Dungeon by clicking the Red Statue

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/0149fbc650d2586bb3a0a47d557f583f1e530f90.png[/img]

Defeat all deviant waves, including one Sub-Boss and one Final Boss. The final boss will have 2 forms.

[b]Sacred Flower Dungeon[/b]
Enter the Sacred Flower Dungeon by clicking the Blue Statue. Enter the True Sacred Flower Dungeon by clicking.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/7d95ecea76292a3bc47be5acdf5d426ff21e27a9.png[/img]

Defeat all deviant waves, including one Sub-Boss and one Final Boss. The final boss will have 2 forms.

[h2]Rewards[/h2]
You can receive additional contribution rewards when you party up with 4 players. The type of rewards is differentiated between Normal and True difficulty. Rewards will be distributed according to who has dealt the most damage to the boss monster. (Same system as East & West Temple.) For a limited time, True difficulty dungeons will give 1 extra Clan Additional Reward Box for both Solo and Party Dungeons.

The reward UI can be accessed by clicking the green gift box on the right-hand side of your screen.

notes.title: Event: Training for a Hot Summer
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/d9175a4d4e2479343a39f975a542f18a0c7ba847.jpg[/img]

Summer is on its way, but your summer bod has yet to arrive! We have just the event to whip you into shape! Storyteller Kong Son Myeong has a training regimen, designed to increase your vital energy, where you can earn powerful relics by completing quests. And if you're looking to test your newfound strength, The Three Princesses is seeking revenge on the Iwami Clan for bitter childhood memories. Of course, you will be well rewarded for your efforts. While you're there, you might as well take advantage of the clamming season in Hainan! Log in and make those summer gains!

[h2]Training for a Hot Summer Event Quests[/h2]

[b]Kong Son-Myeong[/b]
Looking to improve the potency and stamina of your Vital Energy? The storyteller in Hefei knows just the tasks to help you improve in this area of your martial arts, which can only be achieved during the heat of summer! Complete these tasks and earn yourself some powerful relics. Don't wait for time to pass you by!

[i]Road to Karma: [event] Ways to Overcome Summer 1[/i]
NPC: Storyteller, Kong Son-Myeong (Hefei)
Condition: Level 157+ and kill [infinite] Guardian Beast (Infinite Dungeon 10th Floor)
Reward: Small Blue Moon Flower

[i]Road to Karma: [event] Ways to Overcome Summer 2[/i]
NPC: Storyteller, Kong Son-Myeong (Hefei)
Condition: Level 157+ and kill Golden Touch of Golden Castle (Golden Castle Red Pass)
Reward: Blooming Blue Moonflower

[i]Road to Karma: [event] Ways to Overcome Summer 3[/i]
NPC: Storyteller, Kong Son-Myeong (Hefei)
Condition: Level 157+ and kill (Extreme) North Sea Queen (Icy Palace Dungeon Red Pass)
Reward: Frozen Blue Moonflower

[i]Road to Karma: [event] Ways to Overcome Summer 4[/i]
NPC: Storyteller, Kong Son-Myeong (Hefei)
Condition: Level 157+ and hit Black Witch Goku once. (Closed Mine in Kunlun)
Reward: Small Blue Moon Flower

[i]Kong Son-Myeong Resource List[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/7694b66c763157da5667ca24098f021e55c7b5e7.png[/img]

[b]The Three Princesses [/b]
What better place to test your newfound strength than against the Iwami Clan, sworn enemies of the Three Princesses of the North Sea! Make your way to Hainan and settle the score over the trespasses against the royal family.

[i]Road to Karma: [event] The Princess's Unpleasant Memories 1[/i]
NPC: Three Princesses (Hefei)
Condition: Level 229+ and Hit the Bloodsea Yin-Yang Head once
Reward: First Clam Box (Hainan Island)

[i]Road to Karma: [event] The Princess's Unpleasant Memories 2[/i]
NPC: Three Princesses (Hefei)
Condition: Level 229+ and Hit the Bloodsea Princess Whitebead once
Reward: First Clam Box (Hainan Island)

[h2]Clamming Season in Hainan[/h2]
This time of year is the best time to hunt for clams in the tropical island of Hainan. However, the leaders of the Iwami clan, who have claimed residency on the island, have a monopoly on all the harvesting. Defeat these deviants and take back the delicacies they have selfishly seized for themselves! These items have highly decorative shells and can be used as ornaments in wardrobes or weapons, and can even be traded in for some powerful relics!

[b]Hainan Event Drops[/b]

[i]During the event Bloodsea Yin-Yang Head can drop the following item:[/i]
Blood Clam (Hainan Island)

[i]During the event Bloodsea Princess Iwami can drop the following item:[/i]
Oyster (Hainan Island)

[i]During the event Bloodsea Black Dragon Prince can drop the following item:[/i]
Horse Clam (Hainan Island)

[i]During the event Bloodsea Princess Whitebead can drop the following item:[/i]
Geoduck (Hainan Island)

notes.title: Summer is Coming
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/4e228bff2d463a47b9d461d66f31b1c99245a827.jpg[/img]

Summer is coming, and that means fantastic weather, and even greater events to participate in while you escape the heat! Take on legendary creatures and forgotten recluse masters for a chance to make new Relics, Costumes, and Guardians that will keep you ahead of the fire. Log in today to see what's hot!

[h2]Plain Wind Buff[/h2]
Despite the blazing heat, a refreshing breeze comes in the form of the Plain Wind Buff. The following bonuses will run for the event period's duration.
[list]
[*]Maximum Life increases by 10000
[*]Maximum Vital Energy increases by 10000
[/list]
The Plain Wind Buff will last for 180 minutes. When the buff expires, you can relog to receive the buff again.


[h2]Three Legged Blood Spirit[/h2]
The air in Hefei has been set ablaze with unbearable heat, reducing the once bustling marketplace into a ghost town. The culprit is none other than the legendary Three Legged Blood Spirit, known to bring intense heat wherever it appears. The only way to quell this insatiable weather is to face the beast head on.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/d79b58d5da45d14799bf883b362cd92ba2c213e9.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*]Increase Exp gain by 20%
[*]Increase Item Drop rate by 20%
[*]Increase Kung Fu Experience by 20%
[/list]

[h2]Summer is Coming Event Quests[/h2]
With the legendary Three Legged Blood Spirit roosting in Hefei, the people of the village are unable to escape the blazing heat that the fiery bird brings with it. A bounty has been placed, seeking any warriors who can thwart this mythical creature, in order to bring the cool air back to Hefei.

Heroic Quest (Daily): Beat the Heat
NPC: Festival Merchant Seo Hwarang
Condition: Lv 150+ and attack the Three Legged Blood Spirit
Reward: Three Legged Marble

notes.title: Event: Fu-Nanchoo
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/45dc267cf6cd8c415518b25875c0bba0caec5696.png[/img]

The infamous mad cult scientist Fu-Nanchoo is a killer on the loose, aiming for world domination. Rumor has it that his experiments involve creating clones of evil deviants, and even himself, to aid him in his evil plights. It is up to you to stop this criminal mastermind in his tracks! Bring him to justice and you may be able to obtain some of the items that helped him rise to power!

This event will run simultaneously with the [URL=https://forums.playredfox.com/index.php?threads/spring-is-coming.55971/]Spring is Coming Event[/url].

[h2]Virtuous Aura Buff[/h2]
In the face of true danger, a virtuous aura fills the air. The following bonuses will run for the event duration.
[list]
[*]Maximum Life increases by 5000
[*]Maximum Vital Energy increases by 15000
[*]Movement Speed increases by 20%
[/list]
The Virtuous Aura Buff will last for 180 minutes. When the buff expires, you can relog to receive the buff again.

[h2]The Many Faces of Fu-Nanchoo[/h2]
Fu-Nanchoo is on the loose and has his sights set on ruling all of The Land. He as been seen in several places at the same time, so it is questionable which one is the real Fu-NanChoo, if any of them at all. Recently he has been seen in Bamboo Village, Bloody Plain, and Liaodong.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/5c2b3a95e81375e5be2ce6f34003e8f730829efd.jpg[/img]

[*]Elixir Box (Lv5)
[*]Taoist Water Herb

[*]Aralia Spinosa Beef Roll (Untradable)
[*]Jade (Lake Type)
[*]Jade (Waterfall Type)
[*]Jade (Sunken-rock Type)
[*]Jade (Moor Type)
[/list]

[b][SIZE=5]Fu-NanChoo Event Quests[/size][/b]
As the menace known as Fu-NanChoo runs rampant, terrorizing all The Land, the bounty on his head has reached an all-time high. Start your investigation by accepting the event quest available from Festival Trainee Baekhwa for clues which will lead you to the arrest of this wanted criminal!

Heroic Quest (Weekly): Catch the Criminal, Fu-Nanchoo
NPC: Festival Trainee Baekhwa
Condition: Level 228+ and hit Corrupted Mei Shan-Hei in Fu-NanChoo Normal Dungeon.
Reward: [event] Purple Stone in Qingdao (3)

[h2]Fu-Nanchoo Event Dungeons[/h2]
Recent intel has uncovered the whereabouts of Fu-NanChoo and his minions. Put an end to the current reign of terror that befalls The Land by infiltrating his known hideouts.

notes.title: Spring is Coming
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/87de292dc781c8ae0e2cb99bc43746d5bc3ba643.png[/img]

With the coming of spring, warmth fills the air and the smell of flowers blooming saturate the land. To celebrate the spring solstice, we have prepared some great events you can participate in to create powerful Accessories, Relics, and Potions that are sure to help turn the tide of battle. Log in to see what this spring event has to offer!

[h2]Spring Buff[/h2]
With the warm wind of spring comes the blessings of the Spring Buff. The following bonuses, will run for the event period's duration.
[list]
[*]Body Damage increases by 500
[*]Maximum Life increases by 10000
[*]Maximum Vital Energy increases by 10000
[/list]
The Spring Buff will last for 180 minutes. When the buff expires, you can relog to receive the buff again.

[h2]Playtime Bonus[/h2]
Each day you log in, make sure to click your “Stamp Tracker” icon located below the mini-map in the game to receive your reward(s). During the event duration you can receive one Cherry Blossom Buds by logging in for one hour through Daily Playtime Bonus, and an [Event] Cherry Blossom Buds Box by logging in for 110 hours through Monthly Playtime Bonus.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/8f3d602d6d54c0a676547131b7e7badee8dbab03.png[/img]

[list]
[*]Click the “Stamp Tracker” icon below the game's mini-map to display the Accumulated Event.
[*]You must achieve a cumulative amount of minutes/hours over the event period logged in to receive the event prizes.
[*]The prizes are cumulative. If you qualified for a higher tier of Playtime rewards, you would receive all lower tiers.
[/list]
[Event] Cherry Blossom Buds Box Contains the following items.
[list]
[*]Cherry Blossom Buds (60)
[*]Gold Traditional Pattern Piece (3)
[/list]

[h2]Spring Event Dungeons[/h2]

There is a new strange power that looms over the land in the form of great crystals, linking distant lands through a series of portals that can only be entered using ancient Red and Gold Traditional Pattern Pieces. Fortunately, one of those portals has presented itself in Bamboo Village.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/c213484d0dc214fdd500e2252d785a8e9de92f49.jpg[/img]

The Great Crystal Dungeons can be entered at coordinates (126, 140) in the area circled in the map below.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/38f347fbbe5f870e841da5df38de649b52a15607.png[/img]

[b]Great Crystal Dungeon (Hard)[/b]
Enter the portal to the hard dungeon which will lead you directly to the great crystals where you can put an end to the threat brought upon the land. Keep in mind that the closer you get to the source of its power, the stronger the deviants you will run into. This dungeon can be entered using 3x Gold Traditional Pattern Pieces.

notes.title: Event: 7th Anniversary Celebration
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/3dbb59bb90b553eb1ed2575957ccd2552edfc4b9.png[/img]

Come one, come all! The time has come to celebrate 9Dragons Awaken's 7th Anniversary! We are more than thankful for those who have joined us on this journey thus far, and are excited to share the road ahead! To show our appreciation, We have put together an assortment of events you can participate in to join in the festivities!

[h2]7th Anniversary Gift[/h2]
Spark off the celebration and claim 3x 7th Anniversary Silver Dragon Coins simply by logging into game! You can claim this gift by clicking on the gift box icon or pressing the (H) key. Use these items to participate in daily event quests, and/or trade them in for valuable items from the Festival Merchant NPC's. (The 7th Anniversary Gift can be claimed once per account during the event duration)

[h2]7th Anniversary Buff[/h2]
In celebration of our 7th anniversary, we're activating the following bonuses, which will run for the event period's duration.
[list]
[*]Soul Damage increases by 777
[*]All Resistance increased by 777
[*]Maximum Life increases by 17777
[*]Maximum Vital Energy increases by 17777
[/list]
The 7th Anniversary Event Buff will last for 180 minutes. When the buff expires, you can relog to receive the buff again.

[h2]Playtime Bonus[/h2]
Each day you log in, make sure to click your “Stamp Tracker” icon located below the mini-map in the game to receive your reward(s). During the event duration you can receive an [event] 7th Anniversary Gift Box by logging in for one hour, daily!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/d588b7a59147c3cd2f2bef95a0c37112d8e36f23.png[/img]

[list]
[*]Click the “Stamp Tracker” icon below the game's mini-map to display the Accumulated Event.
[*]You must achieve a cumulative amount of minutes/hours over the event period logged in to receive the event prizes.
[*]The prizes are cumulative. If you qualified for a higher tier of Playtime rewards, you would receive all lower tiers.
[/list]
[event] 7th Anniversary Gift Box contains the following items.
[list]
[*]Supporting Korean Ginseng (2)
[*]Kung Du Exp Boost (1 Hour)
[*]Water Herb for GM
[*]7th Anniversary Silver Dragon Coin
[/list]

[h2]Celebration Bell[/h2]
The bell is back to celebrate 9Dragons 7th Anniversary! Ring the bell to bring fortune across the land!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/924cad821a88286a300657df31c55fe72e4e3dc4.png[/img]

[b]Celebration Bell Buff[/b]

[*]Increase Item Drop Rate by 20%
[*]Kung Fu Experience by 20%
[/list]
[i]Celebration Bell can drop the following items.[/i]

[*]Bell of Wishes
[*]7th Anniversary Silver Dragon Coin
[*]7th Anniversary Gold Dragon Coin
[/list]

[h2]7th Anniversary Event Quests[/h2]
As trouble brews in Bamboo Village, the festival merchants urge your support in ridding deviants that rampage the town!

NPC: Festival Trainee Baekhwa (Hefei)
Condition: Level 150+ and defeat the True Bandit Boss

notes.title: Christmas 2022
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/bd0ac89aea2f4b7373d0dd17606373f7a80bf49b.png[/img]

Deck the land with branches of splendor! As the most wonderful time of the year is just around the corner, get into the spirit of Christmas with some holly jolly events that are sure to make your spirit bright! This year, is quite the bonanza, including event field monsters, special dungeons, and a chance to obtain an assortment of Christmas Costumes, Relics, and Consumables! Log in and join in on the festivities today!

[h2]Jingle Bell Buff[/h2]
With the sound of the reindeer's sleigh bells, you will notice the rise of Christmas Spirit! Celebrate the coming of Christmas with the following bonus!
[list]
[*]Maximum Life / Vital Energy increases by 20,000
[/list]
The Jingle Bell Buff will last for 180 Minutes. When the buff expires, you can relog to receive the buff again.

[h2]Playtime Bonus[/h2]
Each day, you can receive a [christmas] Present Box through Daily Playtime Bonus. You will also be able to receive 7 [christmas] Ice Box through Monthly Playtime Bonus.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/2d39dc10b858c6f954d046a502060737b1027a3a.png[/img]

[list]
[*]Click the “Stamp Tracker” icon below the game's mini-map to display the Accumulated Event.
[*]You must achieve a cumulative amount of minutes/hours over the event period logged in to receive the event prizes.
[*]The prizes are cumulative. If you qualified for a higher tier of Playtime rewards, you would receive all lower tiers.
[/list]
[i][Christmas] Present Box contains the following items[/i]
[list]
[*]Courier Guild Transport Pass
[*]Lion's Roar (The Land)
[*]Item Bonus Card x2
[*][christmas] Ice Box
[/list]

[i][Christmas] Ice Box contains one of the following items[/i]
[list]
[*][Christmas] Snowball (1~7)
[*][Christmas] Present Box
[*]Small Bottle of Dragon's Breath
[/list]

[h2]Christmas Quests[/h2]
As Christmas rolls it's way into Hefei, you will be called on to help with various quests to make this holiday season a memorable one!

[i]Heroic Quest (Daily): Shall we exchange [Christmas] Socks?[/i]
NPC: Festival Merchant Seo Hwarang (Hefei)
Condition: LVL 150+ and have 150 [Christmas] Snowball

[i]Heroic Quest (Weekly): Runaway Rudolph[/i]
NPC: Festival Trainee Jeoksam (Hefei)
Condition: LVL 150+ and hit Red Rudolph (North Sea Field Monsters)
Reward: Christmas Ice Box

The [Christmas] Rudolph Mobs are spawned in groups and can be found in the areas circled in red.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/4f37b3de6196c5c33846f3f15cde38f57ee4de7b.png[/img]

[*]2022 Christmas Gracious Robe for Women (7 Days)
[/list]

[list]
[*][Christmas] Ice Box
[*]2022 Christmas Gracious Robe for Men (7 Days)
[*]2022 Christmas Gracious Robe for Women (7 Days)
[*][Christmas] Tinkle Jingle
[/list]

[h2]Christmas Dungeons in Qingdao[/h2]
Holidays across the land is a sight to behold, however it doesn't hold a candle to Qingdao. Clear the event dungeons in Qingdao in the rush to collect Christmas Materials for this season of giving!

[b]Backstreet in Qingdao - North Sea Icy Palace Dungeon[/b]
In the style of Icy Palace, the Backstreet Dungeon has come alive with Christmas cheer! Battle other deviants to collect everything you need to make this Christmas a bright one. The entrance to the dungeon can be found by the Qingdao front entrance at coordinates (300,82).

The [b]Normal mode[/b] can be accessed by using 3x [Christmas] Snowball, which can be obtained from the [christmas] Ice Box, available as a lucky box item from the [christmas] Present Box and [Christmas] Bundle Box, Monthly Playtime Bonus, item drop from the [Event] Rudolphs, as well as both Christmas Dungeons. (Party: 1~2 | Condition: LVL 150+)

The [b]Hard mode[/b] can be accessed by using 1 [Christmas] Socks, which can be obtained from the [Christmas] Ice Box, available as a lucky box item from the [Christmas] Bundle Box, Monthly Playtime Bonus, item drop from the [Event] Blue Rudolph, as well as both Christmas Dungeons. (Party: 2~4 | Condition: LVL 193+)

notes.title: Contest: Halloween Carving 2022
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/b1cb82af261faf7b62db8c6d8e5bb68801984fe9.png[/img]

As clouds loom over the Autumn sky, only the light from the jack-o' lanterns shines through the darkness of the land. Use your imagination and creative abilities, and submit a photo of your best jack-o-lantern carving for the chance to win some hauntingly amazing prizes that will get you out of your britches!

Submission Date: October 27, 2022 - November 21, 2022
Winners Announcement: November 24, 2022

[b]How to Enter[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Carve your choice of pumpkin, squash, fruits, or melon.
[*]Snap a photo with a hand-written postcard displaying your character name, Halloween Carving 2022, and [url=http://www.playredfox.com/nine_dragons]www.playredfox.com/nine_dragons[/url].
[list]
[*][i]Example:[/i]
[list]
[*][gm]Ahri
[*]Halloween Carving 2022
[*][url=http://www.playredfox.com/nine_dragons]www.playredfox.com/nine_dragons[/url]
[/list]
[/list]
[*]Then click the UPLOAD A FILE button below to submit your entry.
[/list]

[i]Submission Tips:[/i]
[list]
[*]Try to take the best picture possible, as picture quality helps make a good impression on the judges.
[*]Get the lighting right. Some jack-o-lanterns will look best lit up at night. Others call for a dramatically cloudy daytime sky or even full sunshine. Experiment to see what looks best for you.
[*]Pay close attention to the background of your carving.
[*]You can have a look at past winners [url=https://forums.playredfox.com/index.php?threads/contest-halloween-carving-2021-winners-announced.53467/]here.[/url]
[/list]

[b]Prizes[/b]
[list]
[*]1st (1 Winner) - 10,000 RedFox Credits
[*]2nd (1 Winners) - 7,500 RedFox Credits
[*]3rd (1 Winners) - 5,000 RedFox Credits
[*]4th (2 Winners) - 2,500 RedFox Credits
[*]5 Lucky Winners will randomly receive 1,000 RedFox Credits
[/list]
[i]Winners selection is based on submission and is subject to change. [/i]

[b]Rules & Restrictions[/b]
[list]
[*]Participants must submit their entries by replying to this official [url=https://forums.playredfox.com/index.php?threads/halloween-carving-2022.55113/]Contest thread.[/url] 
[*]Participants can enter as many different pumpkins as they'd like per account.
[*]Entries that do not meet these requirements will be disqualified.
[*]Prizes will be granted to the posting account and non-transferable to a different account.
[*]Entries cannot contain any material that violates the Forum Code of Conduct or Terms of Service.
[*]Winners will be determined by the subjective judgment of the 9Dragons team.
[*]Keep the thread clean; off-topic will be deleted.
[/list]

notes.title: Fall Festival
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/e30b5ffa56f7764a826f1cb7d1f74fb024b82313.png[/img]

There are so many reasons to love the Fall. You get Halloween, for one, a time to be spooky, and Thanksgiving, a time of sharing and being thankful for everything we have. To celebrate them both, we have a cornucopia of eerily fantastic events to brighten up the fall mood! Enjoy event quests, buffs, dungeons, and Hero Tournaments, for a chance to obtain exclusive costumes, bags, and relics and earn some highly sought-after materials. Don't miss your chance and log in today!

[h2]Fall Festival Buff[/h2]
Celebrate the change in season from Summer to Fall with the following bonuses.
[list]
[*]Maximum Life Increases by 30000
[*]Attack Speed increases by 20%
[/list]
The Fall Festival Buff will last for 180 minutes. When the buff expires, you can relog to receive the buff again.

[h2]Thanksgiving Gift[/h2]
Once per account during the event, you can receive a free [event] Thanksgiving Present Box! To receive this item, click on the gift icon on the right of your game window, or press the H key to pull up the Event Window.

[i][Event] Thanksgiving Present Box contains the following items.[/i]
[list]
[*]Couriers Guild Voucher
[*]Lion's Roar (The Land)
[*]Item Bonus Card
[*][Low] Rooster Lucky Box (Rank 3) contains one of the following items.
[list]
[*][Rank 1] Rooster
[*][Rank 2] Rooster Box
[/list]
[/list]
Note: The [Event] Thanksgiving Present Box is bound to the character and cannot be traded or stored.

[h2]Playtime Bonus[/h2]
Each day, you can receive an [Event] Item Bonus Card (3X) through Daily Playtime Bonus. You will also be able to receive 5 [Event] Halloween Tickets through the Monthly Playtime Bonus.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/016e2e5dd51cdce9b13bf31e9588632977491720.png[/img]

[list]
[*]Click the “Stamp Tracker” icon below the game's mini-map to display the Accumulated Event.
[*]You must achieve a cumulative amount of minutes/hours over the event period logged in to receive the event prizes.
[*]The prizes are cumulative. If you qualified for a higher tier of Playtime rewards, you would receive all lower tiers.
[/list]

[h2]Fall Festival Quests[/h2]
With the Couriers Guild involved with the Fall Festival, you can guarantee there will be plenty of quests to participate in to earn rewards you can use in the event!

[i]Heroic Quest (Daily): Do you need a [Event] Halloween Ticket?[/i]
[list]
[*]NPC: Festival Trainee Baekhwa (Hefei)
[*]Condition: LVL 150+
[*]Reward: [Event] Halloween Ticket
[/list]

[i]Heroic Quest (Daily): Troublesome Brothers in Bamboo Village[/i]
[list]
[*]NPC: Festival Merchant Seo Hwarang (Hefei)
[*]Condition: LVL 150+ Can be completed by attacking the Tremendous Swordsmen in Bamboo Village.
[*]Reward: 2x [Event] Halloween Ticket
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/16f69d457702c9efdbb4060702709c7807cb856f.png[/img]

[i]Tremendous Flaming Swordsman and Tremendous Soul Swordsman Drops:[/i]
[list]
[*]Common Pumpkin (5)
[*]Lit Candle
[*][Event] Thanksgiving Present Box
[*][Event] Halloween Ticket
[*][Halloween] Pumpkin Candy
[*]Sales Pocket (10 Million)
[/list]

Note: To complete the Troublesome Brothers in Bamboo Village quest, you will need to attack the Tremendous Soul Swordsman and Tremendous Flaming Swordsman once in the Highland area of Bamboo Village. You will need to hit both Brothers for the quest to mark your attacks.

[h2]Fall Festival Dungeons in Qingdao[/h2]
Qingdao is known for having the highest quality pumpkins on the land. Friend and foe alike are scouring the area in search of these delights. Clear the event dungeons in Qingdao to ensure the greatest Fall Festival the land has ever seen!

[b]Backstreet Dungeon[/b]
During the Halloween season, the veil around Qingdao's backstreets has thinned, and evil spirits are attracted to the desire for pumpkins. Defeat these deviants and recover the pumpkins and other spookily desired items in the Backstreet Dungeon.

The entrance to the dungeon can be found by the Qingdao front entrance at coordinates (300,82) and accessed by using the [Event] Halloween Ticket, which can be obtained via the event Daily Quest, Playtime Bonus, and Festival Trainee Baekwa Resource. You can also obtain them as drops from the Backstreet Dungeon and Mainstreet Dungeon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/ef18f92b5ea86c890f9994b6381c0f3e630b0232.png[/img]

Defeat the many evil spirits that plague the back streets of Qingdao for a chance to collect event materials and an exclusive event bag set! (Party: 1~4 | Condition: LVL 150+)

The entrance to the dungeon can be found near Ghiryu Tower at coordinates (250,305). [h2]Hero Tournament[/h2]
With the Couriers Guild involved, there would have to be a Hero Tournament in the Fall Festival! For the duration of this event, players can duke it out in 3 different level ranges to see who is the strongest in their bracket. The winners will receive a timed  Triumph Official Costume and a Hero Reward Box containing Relics, Ornaments, Tender Stone of Nine Divines, and 2 Dragon Candle Plugs, used to enter the Mainstreet Dungeon. The winner of the last bracket of each day will receive a 30-day costume. Also, whether you participated or not, you can log into Hefei before the end of the last competition to receive the Hero's Protection Buff!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/d74f80d90b93f480dfe891c81b275d2af3c93f0e.png[/img]

[*]Hero Tournament is separated into 3 brackets: 150-199, 200-239, and 240-255.
[*]Every match will have a duration of 15 minutes.
[*]Hero Tournament details can be viewed through the Hero Tournament NPC.
[*]Once the tournament starts, players can enter the arena by talking to the Hero Tournament NPC. Entering the Arena will display the Kill/Death UI.
[*]The player with the most kills and the least deaths will become the winner.
[*]When players are killed, they will get teleported out of the arena and need to talk to the NPC to re-enter.
[*]You will need 3 empty slots to receive the event rewards. (1 Costume will be given depending on the character's gender)
[*]Rewards will be distributed after each competition.
[*]After the 240-255 level bracket, every player in Hefei will receive the Hero's Protection Buff, regardless of participation.
[*]The reward will not be given if the winner is not logged in at the end of the competition.

[list]
[*]Routine server checks.

Entelechy Art of Heaven and Earth (League of Beggars), Summoning Spirits of Fire Ghost (Sacred Flower), Diamond Art of Power (Shaolin), Demon Healing of Blood The Sky (Heavenly Demon), and Armored Art of Power (Brotherhood) are PvP exclusive skills.

[*]Hero Band and Master & Disciple applicant lists will be reset.

[/list]

Thank you for your patience during the maintenance.

notes.title: Moonlight Festival
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/ca5d4c5c5959837f4f66e2be25247cd1478120a4.png[/img]

With the coming of the harvest moon, let us celebrate this bountiful harvest with an abundance of events in store and bring fortune to all across the land! Join all there is to offer with server buffs, field bosses, and special event dungeons for a chance to obtain new bags, accessories, costumes, and more!

[h2]Moonlight Buff[/h2]
Celebrate the coming of the harvest moon and a bountiful harvest with the following bonuses.
[list]
[*]Maximum Life increased by 5000
[*]Vital Energy increases by 15000
[*]Movement Speed increases by 20%
[/list]
The Moonlight buff will last for 180 minutes. When the buff expires, you can relog to receive the buff again.

[h2]Playtime Bonus[/h2]
Each day, you can receive 1 [event] Moon Festival Ticket, and once during the month of the event, you can receive 5 [event] Moon Festival Tickets. Use these tickets to enter the Back Street event dungeon in Qingdao.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/b4cfd7778607aa0553f35188314770b584c83044.png[/img]

[list]
[*]Click the “Stamp Tracker” icon below the game's mini-map to display the Accumulated Event.
[*]You must achieve a cumulative amount of minutes/hours over the event period logged in to receive the event prizes.
[*]The prizes are cumulative. If you qualified for a higher tier of Playtime rewards, you would also receive all lower tiers.
[/list]

[h2]Moonlight Quests[/h2]
With the Moonlight Festival at hand, the villagers could use your help! Offer your strength to earn some rewards that will help you get ahead in this event!

[i]Heroic Quest (Daily): Do you need a [event] Moon Festival Ticket?[/i]
[list]
[*]NPC: Festival Trainee Baekhwa (Hefei)
[*]Condition: Lvl 150+
[*]Reward: [event] Moon Festival Ticket
[/list]

[i]Heroic Quest (Daily): Crisis of Naxian Village[/i]
[list]
[*]NPC: Festival Merchant Seo Hwarang (Hefei)
[*]Condition: Lvl 150+ Can be completed by landing 1 hit on [moon] Crimson Nine-tail Fox
[*]Reward: [event] Full Moon (2)
[/list]

[i]Heroic Quest (Daily): Naughty Dog in Hefei[/i]
[list]
[*]NPC: Festival Trainee Jeoksam (Hefei)
[*]Condition: Lvl 150+ Can be completed by landing 1 hit on [moon] Blood Wolf
[*]Reward: [event] Full Moon
[/list]

Note: To Complete the Naughty Dog in Hefei quest, you will need to hit the [moon] Blood Wolf with your normal attack. (Double-click on target to use basic attack)

[h2]Moon Blood Wolf and Moon Crimson Nine-Tail Fox[/h2]
With the Mid Autumn Moon coming, the Moon Blood Wolf and the Moon Crimson Nine-Tail Fox will descend from the heavens to wreak havoc across the land. Additionally, you would do well to remember that completing the Moonlight Festival quests will involve your participation in defeating these monsters! Log in and do your part!

The [moon] Blood Wolf will spawn in Hefei's Scrolling Valley and will respawn every 2 hours. Although it does not drop any items, defeating the [moon] Blood Wolf will grant the Carnival of the Moon Buff for the whole server!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/c335f56f20971215ff54a92d4b4ef0cccdea9c50.png[/img]

Upon Defeating the [moon] Blood Wolf, the following Buff will be applied to the server for 45 minutes.

[i]Carnival of the Moon[/i]
[list]
[*]Increases Exp gain by 20%
[*]Increase Item Drop by 20%
[*]Increase Kung Fu Experience by 20%
[/list]

The [moon] Crimson Nine-tail Fox will spawn in North Sea Icy Palace, outside of Naxian Village, respawn every 11 hours, and drop up to 10 [event] Red Moons for whoever defeats it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/8e9eff56dc6d21b6a4371a47f4f45ed485fae7ad.png[/img]

[h2]Moon Festival Dungeons in Qingdao[/h2]
With all the gatherings for the Moon Festival in Qingdao, trouble is sure to follow. Clear the event dungeons and help Qingdao celebrate the mid-autumn harvest!

[i]Adamantine Force and Black Dragon's Trap[/i]
The following Buffs and Debuffs will be activated when entering the event dungeons.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/c335f56f20971215ff54a92d4b4ef0cccdea9c50.png[/img]

[b]Backstreet Dungeon[/b]
Packs of spiteful deviants take to the backstreets of Qingdao with aim of looting the Moonlight Festival. The entrance to the Backstreet Dungeon can be found by the Qingdao front entrance at coordinates (300,82) and entered using the [event] Moon Festival Ticket, which can be obtained via event daily quest, as well as daily and monthly Playtime Bonus.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/1131786fa9018a10455e3d9fee4b0324f3890f2a.png[/img]

Enter with up to a party of 3, and defeat the many foes that aim to ruin the Moon Festival for a chance to collect event materials and an exclusive event bag set!

[i]Backstreet Dungeon Drops:[/i]
[list]
[*][event] Full Moon
[*]Couriers Guild Voucher
[*]Hazy Nine-Tail Fox Bag 1 (M)
[*]Hazy Nine-Tail Fox Bag 2 (M)
[*]Hazy Nine-Tail Fox Bag 1 (F)
[*]Hazy Nine-Tail Fox Bag 2 (F)
[*][event] Purple Stone of Qingdao
[/list]
[b]
Main Street Dungeon[/b]
Giant ravenous roosters are rampaging Qingdao's main street, and it's up to you to slay them! The Entrance to the Main Street Dungeon can be found near Ghiryu Tower at coordinates (250,305). You will need the [event] Purple Stone of Qingdao to enter this dungeon. [event] Purple Stones can either be dropped from the Backstreet Dungeon or obtained through the [event]Moonlight Box.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/6dbf348b860c9f820a6ad6b3284edba82f62626a.png[/img]

This dungeon is a wave format dungeon in which you will need to defeat Big and Shiny Roosters before they disappear. The Big and Shiny Roosters will be hard if not impossible to kill alone, so join in a party of up to 8 people. Killing Next Stage Hens will drop items, as well as summon the next wave of Big Roosters. Shiny Roosters will be summoned at the 3rd Stage.

[list=1]
[*]The Event Rooster, in the north of Qingdao, is there to provide the basic rules of the event dungeon.
[*]Due to the moon's brightness, Roosters are very resilient and have a higher resistance to Yin.
[*]Add any combination of Yin, Yang, Body, and Soul Damage to increase your ability to defeat the Roosters.
[*]Drop Rate increases of any kind are recommended for getting the most out of the Main Street Dungeon drops.
[*]Roosters can get exhausted, so beat them before they disappear; otherwise, you will not get any rewards.
[*]Defeating the Roosters alone is impossible, so be sure to party up with other members!
[*]Roosters are immune to CC. Stun and Area skills are not applied.
[*]Once a Shiny Rooster is defeated, the dungeon will be completed, so in order to kill both of them, they should be killed at the same time.
[*]As some players may have difficulty finding a large party to play with, players will be able to obtain items from the Next Stage Hens.
[/list]

Dear Nine Dragons Community,

The servers will undergo maintenance and server update on June 21, 2022, at 18:30 server time. The downtime will be approximately 3 hours.

[list]

[*] Fixed an issue where there is an invisible barrier in Hefei.
[*] Fixed an issue where the client enters the lock screen state, and the character model appears black during character creation.
[*] Fixed an issue where the bottom wall of Black Cloud Basin in Qingdao is outside the safety zone.

notes.title: Server Maintenance: 6/7/22 | Patch 305
notes.notes:
Dear Nine Dragons Community,

The servers will undergo maintenance and server update on June 7, 2022, at 18:30 server time. The downtime will be approximately 3 hours.

[b]Changes and Updates:[/b]
[list]
[*] Routine server checks.
[*] White Dragon Treasure event will end.
[*] Father's Day event will begin.
[*] Weapon refinement levels 19, and 20 damage output has been increased.
[*] System message that appears to all players upon succeeding refinement level 15 has been changed to level 16.
[*] The position of the wristband and shoes in the Character Window (C) has been swapped.
[*] Fixed an issue where the "Cancel" button will appear randomly on the left side of your character's bag.
[*] Changed client support to Microsoft Windows 7 (32bit) or higher operating system.
[*] Changed the browser used for in-game web view and web page out link to MS IE11 → MS Edge.
[*] Added a function to guide the installation of WebView2 Runtime when running the Client on a PC that does not have WebView2 Runtime installed. The WebView2 Runtime installation file is automatically downloaded, but you must click the downloaded file to install it.
[*] Hero Band and Master & Disciple applicant lists will be reset.
[*] Infinite Dungeon ranking will be reset, and points will be distributed to the top 50.
[/list]

Thank you for your patience during the maintenance.

notes.title: Update: Wu-Tang and Yanmo Dungeons
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/222cc7cdc47f2952d2c897c8414ee54ae82c3d65.png[/img]

The Black Dragons Clan has been spreading throughout the land and has ended up particularly close to home. With headquarters reaching into both the Wu-Tang and Heavenly Demon, it is up to you to investigate and eradicate the splinters from within your clan. It will be dangerous, however, with great risk, comes even greater rewards. In this update, we are introducing two new raid format dungeons, in both Wu-Tang and Mount Yanmo, in which you can obtain materials to create all-new armor sets and a brand new set of skills for all roles.

Access the dungeon solo or party with four players to defeat fearsome monsters and obtain top-tier equipment.
[list]
[*]Level Requirement: 230+
[*]Solo or four players parties can enter the dungeon.
[*]You can choose between Normal and Hard (True) dungeons.
[*]Up to 4 entries are allowed per day. (Solo: Normal/True, Party: Normal/True)
[*]Create New Equipment.
[/list]

[h3]Wu-Tang Dungeon[/h3]
White Clan players can access the Wu-Tang Dungeon in Wu-Tang Shan. Enter the True Wu-Tang Dungeon by clicking the Red Flame. Enter the Wu-Tang Dungeon by clicking the Blue Flame.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/f9cc83fa7f5712b944bc444d9ac3bc704cba04b2.png[/img]

There are a total of 4 stages. Defeat all deviants, including one Sub-Boss and one Final Boss. The door leading into the Final Boss stage will not open until all deviants are defeated.

[h3]Yanmo Dungeon[/h3]
Black Clan players can access the Yanmo Dungeon in Mount Yanmo. Enter True Yanmo Dungeon by clicking the Red Flame. Enter Yanmo Dungeon by clicking the Blue Flame.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/b12c0081dd65092fd268cd36ee749abde99f939d.png[/img]

There are a total of 4 stages. Defeat all deviants, including one Sub-Boss and one Final Boss. The door leading into the Final Boss stage will not open until all deviants are defeated.

[h3]Rewards[/h3]
You can receive additional contribution rewards when you party up with 4 players. The type of rewards is differentiated between Normal and True difficulty. Rewards will be distributed according to who has dealt the most damage to the boss monster. (Same system as East & West Temple.)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/4bff7c6ce424e91e63e1468a73a8dd7219dd6541.png[/img]

The reward UI can be accessed by clicking the green gift box on the right-hand side of your screen.

[h3]New Equipment [/h3]
Items collected from dungeons can be brought to Keum Hoo and Bong Hoo in Hefei, to create new resources and armor.

[i]Master Craftsman, Bong Hoo Resource List[/i]

A new set of powerful skills for each role, including a new lightfoot can now be obtained from the Ancient Secret Restorer, Keumbi Ho in Hefei.

notes.title: Update: Infinite Dungeon Renewal
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/64449698fb8bd97fd44a6559ab7caf99d713efa6.png[/img]

After the long wait, we are happy to release the renewal of the Infinite Dungeon! Get ready to wave goodbye to the Infinite Dungeon you once knew. With all-new challenging stages, reward features, and an updated point system, this update is sure to bring you great power and fortune. Did we mention there are new items, costumes, weapons, AND relics?

[b]About Infinite Dungeon[/b]
[list]
[*]The Infinite Dungeon is accessible to character level Revolving Chakra 1 (37) and above. You can access the dungeon interface by clicking the Infinite Dungeon Tab after pressing the F11 key.
[*]You will gain a certain amount of Challenge Points by clearing each stage while in the dungeon, and higher stages will payout more Challenge Points.
[*]Points earned can be used to buy various items from Infinite Master, Man Sangja.
[*]The number of daily entries to the Infinite Dungeon will be initialized at 00:00 server time, and the ranking will be calculated according to the stage and progress time.
[*]Additional point rewards will be given according to the ranking calculation at the last/first maintenance each month.
[/list]

[b]Stages and Difficulty Re-Adjustment  [/b]
[list]
[*]Stages and Difficulty Re-Adjustment
[*]The number of stages is reduced from 50 Stages to 33 Stages, including 3 Reward Stages. The difficulty of stage 21 is similar to the existing stage 50, and starting at stage 23, it will be more difficult drastically.
[*]3 new bosses will spawn at stage 10, stage 21, and stage 32. The type of boss will appear randomly and have powerful skills.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/10f88e0d3c87f0b03d8270d87a3b8e87f086443e.jpg[/img]


[b]Infinite Entry and Infinite Stone Price Adjustment[/b]
[list]
[*]5 Entries (default) + 5 Entries (Infinite Stone) (10 Total) to 2 Entries (default) + 2 Entries (Infinite Stone) (4 Total).
[*]Infinite Stone (30 RC) to Infinite Stone (60 RC).
[/list]

[b]Be confident in your strength and rush in without the support of a party![/b]
Previously there were 2 modes to enter the Infinite Dungeon Solo and in a Party. However, the Infinite dungeon is now only open to Solo entries. Parties are not welcomed!

[b]Ranking Point Distribution[/b]
Stage Clear points and ranking reward points are adjusted depending on the newly designed number of stages and difficulty level. Each month, individuals on all servers Rank 1~50 will receive the following Challenge Point Rewards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/5a6e24523de33cbc3d2e491f598d5adee7be5769.png[/img]
[/indent]
[i]Infinite Dungeon Ranking will be reset each month during maintenance. Ranking Points will be distributed prior to reset periods.[/i]
[b]
Point Shop Items Changes[/b]
Due to the adjustment of point gain as well as existing points, the cost of point shop items has also been adjusted. Additionally, an assortment of new items has been added.

notes.notes:

At long last, Nine Dragon's 6th Anniversary Event has arrived! We know it hasn't been an easy year, and are more than thankful to have stayed connected through the love of 9D. To show our appreciation, we have a collection of great events that are sure to bring abundance to your game play!

[h2]6th Anniversary Gift[/h2]
Ring in the festivities and claim your 6th Anniversary Gift Box by clicking on the gift box icon or pressing the (H) key. notes.title: Event: Thanksgiving 2021
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/7150a5e41eb1fdf97a44e183775f86ca2a7ed72e.png[/img]

Another year, and there is even more to be Thankful for. We have come far, despite all of the hardships along the way, and we would like to thank all of you for playing with us. It has been an absolute pleasure, and we would not be here without all of you. So this one is for you and everything you are thankful for too! Log in and enjoy the cornucopia of Thanksgiving events we have in store for you, for a chance to obtain some bountiful items in addition to exclusive Thanksgiving Rooster Guardians.

[h3]Thanksgiving Day Buff[/h3]
To honor all that we are grateful for, we are offering the following bonuses, which will run for the duration of the event period.
[list]
[*]Increases Maximum Life by 10000
[*]Increases Vital Energy  by 10000
[*]Increase Life Absorption by 20/1000
[*]Increase Vital Energy Absorption by 20/1000
[*]Critical Hit Chance by 1500/10000
[/list]

The Thanksgiving Day Buff will last for 180 minutes. When the buff expires, you can relog to receive the buff again.

[h3]Thanksgiving Event Playtime Bonus[/h3]
Each day, you can receive 3 [event] Thanksgiving Day Tickets, which can be used to enter the Thanksgiving Dungeon, and 1 [event] Golden Feather Ticket, which in addition to [event] Leather can be exchanged for [event] Golden Feathers!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/e0c6176cae2fe75d7ee2938bd7f5adb0d0418a03.jpg[/img]
[*]Click the “Stamp Tracker” icon located below the mini-map in the game to display the Accumulated Event.
[*]You must achieve a cumulative amount of minutes/hours over the event period logged in to receive the event prizes.
[*]The prizes are cumulative. If you qualified for a higher tier of Playtime rewards, you would also receive all lower tiers.
[/list]
[h3]Collect [event] Leather[/h3]
Defeat field and dungeon mobs over level 150 to collect [event] Leathers and trade them in to Festival Merchant Seo Hwarang for an assortment of items, including timed Relics, Special Event Guardians, and Guardian related items.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/cdb405bcb9d1c90930cab2705c515eb4343e4c58.png[/img]

[i]Seo Hwarang Resource List[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/7623cdca2345f83bd8f23feda273f4288a2744a7.png[/img]

[h3]Thanksgiving Dungeon[/h3]
Use the [event] Thanksgiving Day Tickets from the Playtime Bonus to enter the Thanksgiving Event Dungeon located in Death Valley, to take down the father of all roosters, the [event] Giant Rooster! This boss will drop 8 [event] Golden Feathers upon defeat, so be quick to take it down! These are one of the materials used for upgrading your Rooster Guardians.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/c60dc0f4daa309acc238f4cb853d9b845bfb45c9.png[/img]

[h3]Infinite Dungeon[/h3]
Here's yet another reason to be thankful for the new Infinite Dungeon! During the duration of this event, you will receive 3 [event] Purple Jades for reaching the reward stage on stage 11, and 2 [event] Green Jades for reaching the reward stage on Stage 22. These jades are used for upgrading your Rooster Guardians at Festival Trainee NPC Baekhwa!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/39f6d45bb5214bc9fdc83b87fa11a49607380d26.png[/img]

[i]Baekhwa Resource[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/56738280e0e8c914633ce8a4d137cf501f78cbf0.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/6b761644855cd183f62793c73d9b4f0ce15ca97b.png[/img]

Rank will reflect size and effects of Guardian
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/425f0f6047cf0e7f7fef72bdd49c1db2becbb407.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/cdd36b54b5f2726c107952d06d7e565f16ab4ea4.png[/img]

If you can achieve a [Rank 5] Rooster, you can trade it in to Seo Hwarang for a [special] Rooster Box (Rank 1), which obtains a [special] Thanksgiving Day Ticket, that can be exchanged with Festival Trainee NPC Jeoksam for some really valuable items.

notes.title: Notice: Daylight Saving Time Ends
notes.notes:
Dear Dragons,

Daylight Saving Time is about to end, and clocks will be going back one hour. At 02:00 pacific time on Sunday, November 7th, clocks will go back to 01:00.

We plan to reflect the required time changes to the game during our scheduled maintenance on Tuesday, November 9th. Since server maintenance is the only time we can adapt to the change, the following system times may be slightly affected.

[list]
[*] Black vs. White War
[*] Infinite Dungeon
[*] Storm vs. Storm
[*] Daily Quests
[*] Master & Disciple
[*] Playtime Bonus
[*] Boss Spawns
[/list]

For example, the times will be delayed by one hour or canceled in certain dire cases. Until then, we kindly ask that you note the time change and bear with us.

We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience and thank you for your patience.
