notes.title: Update: Infinite Dungeon Renewal
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/64449698fb8bd97fd44a6559ab7caf99d713efa6.png[/img]

After the long wait, we are happy to release the renewal of the Infinite Dungeon! Get ready to wave goodbye to the Infinite Dungeon you once knew. With all-new challenging stages, reward features, and an updated point system, this update is sure to bring you great power and fortune. Did we mention there are new items, costumes, weapons, AND relics?

[b]About Infinite Dungeon[/b]
[list]
[*]The Infinite Dungeon is accessible to character level Revolving Chakra 1 (37) and above. You can access the dungeon interface by clicking the Infinite Dungeon Tab after pressing the F11 key.
[*]You will gain a certain amount of Challenge Points by clearing each stage while in the dungeon, and higher stages will payout more Challenge Points.
[*]Points earned can be used to buy various items from Infinite Master, Man Sangja.
[*]The number of daily entries to the Infinite Dungeon will be initialized at 00:00 server time, and the ranking will be calculated according to the stage and progress time.
[*]Additional point rewards will be given according to the ranking calculation at the last/first maintenance each month.
[/list]

[b]Stages and Difficulty Re-Adjustment  [/b]
[list]
[*]Stages and Difficulty Re-Adjustment  
[*]The number of stages is reduced from 50 Stages to 33 Stages, including 3 Reward Stages. The difficulty of stage 21 is similar to the existing stage 50, and starting at stage 23, it will be more difficult drastically.
[*]3 new bosses will spawn at stage 10, stage 21, and stage 32. The type of boss will appear randomly and have powerful skills.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/aec4a83abb47255e507606cc3b8451c2cfc0fe7e.png[/img]

[b]Infinite Entry and Infinite Stone Price Adjustment[/b]
[list]
[*]5 Entries (default) + 5 Entries (Infinite Stone) (10 Total) to 2 Entries (default) + 2 Entries (Infinite Stone) (4 Total).
[*]Infinite Stone (30 RC) to Infinite Stone (60 RC).
[/list]

[b]Be confident in your strength and rush in without the support of a party![/b]
Previously there were 2 modes to enter the Infinite Dungeon Solo and in a Party. However, the Infinite dungeon is now only open to Solo entries. Parties are not welcomed!


[b]Ranking Point Distribution[/b]
Stage Clear points and ranking reward points are adjusted depending on the newly designed number of stages and difficulty level. Each month, individuals on all servers Rank 1~50 will receive the following Challenge Point Rewards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/5a6e24523de33cbc3d2e491f598d5adee7be5769.png[/img]

[i]Infinite Dungeon Ranking will be reset each month during maintenance. Ranking Points will be distributed prior to reset periods.[/i]
[b]
Point Shop Items Changes[/b]
Due to the adjustment of point gain as well as existing points, the cost of point shop items has also been adjusted. Additionally, an assortment of new items has been added.

[i]Point Shop Page 1[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/fb1db5c0dd464b216e8b3e80561489785e99f986.png[/img]
[i]Point Shop Page 2[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/018d635708faaa7ab2812bcb74b4982577a91672.png[/img]

[b]Reward Stages[/b]
For reaching stages 11, 22, and 33, you will be granted a special treasure box in which you can receive valuable items. These stages will have no monsters and will not give out any points.

[i]Stage 11 Treasure Box[/i]
Contains one or more of the following items.
[list]
[*]Ultimate Tablet
[*]Wave Healing Stone
[*]Symbol of True Blood Sorcerer
[*]Essence of Hazy Spirit
[*]Annihilation Kylin's Red Eye
[*]Thousand Year Soul
[*]Book of White Dragon (1)

[*]Book of White Dragon (3)
[*]Infinite Spirit Tablet (3)
[*]Infinite Soul Pill (3)
[*]Infinite Spirit (Low)
[*]Infinite Spirit Tablet (2)
[*]Infinite Soul Pill (2)
[*]Forgotten Jade Stone (5)
[/list]

[i]Stage 22 Treasure Box[/i]
Contains one or more of the following items.
[list]
[*]United Spirits Bead

[*]Mystic Silk

Contains one or more of the following items.

Note: Forgotten Jade Stone is used to create materials that are used in the new Jade Dragon Sapphire Willow Weapons from the [url=https://forums.playredfox.com/index.php?threads/qingdao-1st-release-updated-11-29-22.52397/]Qingdao Update.[/url]

[b]Infinite New Equipment[/b]
A new weapon series called Infinite Dark Soul is added. The Infinite Dark Soul weapons can be traded using the latest materials. You can upgrade the Infinite Dark Soul weapons to tier 2, the Infinite Sandstorm Phoenix weapons, which have superior stats.

notes.title: Contest: Halloween Carving 2021
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/12986a1106ea6e90cf2d5258fe3bf080a1d9ee07.jpg[/img]

As the air chills and the nights grow darker, comes the time for jack-o-lanterns to bring their dim light throughout the land, and with them, our Halloween Carving Contest! Using your imagination and creative abilities, you can submit a photo of your best jack-o-lantern carving for the chance to win some frighteningly amazing prizes that you are sure to die for.

Submission Date: October 8, 2021 - October 30, 2021
Winners Announcement: November 5, 2021

[b]How to Enter[/b]
[list]
[*]Carve your choice of pumpkin, squash, fruits, or melon.
[*]Snap a photo with a hand-written postcard displaying your character name and [url=www.playredfox.com/nine_dragons]www.playredfox.com/nine_dragons[/url].
[/list]
[list]
[*][i]Example:[/i]
[list]
[*][gm]Ahri
[*][url=www.playredfox.com/nine_dragons]www.playredfox.com/nine_dragons[/url]
[/list]
[*]Then click the UPLOAD A FILE button below to submit your entry.
[/list]
[i]Submission Tips:[/i]
[list]
[*]Try to take the best picture possible, as picture quality helps make a good impression on the judges.
[*]Get the lighting right. Some jack-o-lanterns will look best lit up at night. Others call for a dramatically cloudy daytime sky or even full sunshine. Experiment to see what looks best for you.
[*]Pay close attention to the background of your carving.
[*]You can have a look at past winners [url=https://forums.playredfox.com/index.php?threads/contest-halloween-carving-2020.51437/]here[/url].
[/list]

[b]Prizes[/b]
[list]
[*]1st (1 Winner) - 7,500 RedFox Credits
[*]2nd (2 Winners) - 5,000 RedFox Credits
[*]3rd (3 Winners) - 2,500 RedFox Credits
[/list]

[b]Rules & Restrictions[/b]
[list]
[*]Participants must submit their entry by replying to this official Contest thread.
[*]Participants can enter as many different pumpkins as you'd like per account.
[*]Prizes will be granted to the posting account and non-transferable to a different account.
[*]Entries cannot contain any material that violates the Forum Code of Conduct or Terms of Service.
[*]Winners will be determined by the subjective judgment of the 9Dragons team.
[*]Keep the thread clean; off-topic will be deleted.
[/list]

notes.title: Contest: Under the Moonlight
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/69a58ef50ff5422951d47426459a578701283ca4.png[/img]

Some of the greatest moments in all the land are only witnessed under the light of the moon. Capturing these great moments may earn you fame, fortune, and a spotlight in history. To participate in this contest, take a screenshot under a moonlit background for a chance to win some great prizes that are sure to guarantee your place amongst the stars!

Submission Date: September 10, 2021 - September 27, 2021
Winners Announcement: October 1, 2021

[b]How to Enter[/b]
[list]
[*]Log into Nine Dragons.
[*]Find a beautiful location and make sure the moon is in the background.
[*]Press F5 to hide UI. Capture a screenshot by pressing Prt Sc.
[*]Post your entry as an attachment on the official Nine Dragons forums as a reply to this thread.
[/list]

[b]Prizes[/b]
[list]
[*]6 Winners: Special Moon Box (10+1) + (Bonus: 11 [cash] Special Moon)
[*]All participants: 500 RC
[/list]

[b]Rules and Restrictions[/b]
[list]
[*]Screenshots MUST include your character with their name visible.
[*]The screenshot must be personally taken by you using the in-game screen capture tool and must be submitted in a digital format (ideally PNG/JPG).
[*]Each participant is limited to a single entry.
[*]Once uploaded, you can edit your post if you come up with a better screenshot.
[*]Prizes will be granted to the posting account and non-transferable to a different account.
[*]Entries cannot contain any material that violates the Forum Code of Conduct or Terms of Service.
[*]Winners will be determined by the subjective judgment of the 9Dragons team.
[*]Keep the thread clean; off-topic will be deleted.
[*]Anyone found making multiple entries on multiple accounts will result in all entries being disqualified.
[*]Screenshots without the moon in the background will not qualify for a prize.
[*]Old screenshots will not qualify for a reward, so make sure you take a new screenshot.
[/list]

[b]Disclaimer:[/b] By submitting your screenshot(s) for our event, you understand and agree that the rights and ownership for the use of the screenshot(s) will automatically belong to RedFox Games and can be used at RedFox Games's discretion.

notes.title: Server Maintenance: 7/6/21 | Patch 254-255
notes.notes:
We will be performing scheduled maintenance beginning on Tuesday, July 6, 2021, at 6:00 PM (PDT) and expect the service to be unavailable for approximately 4-6 hours.

[b]Reason:[/b]
[list]
[*]Routine server checks.
[*]Spirit of Sky's Festival will end.
[*]Life and Death Summer event will begin. You can find full event details [URL='https://forums.playredfox.com/index.php?threads/event-life-and-death-summer.53036/']here[/url].
[*]Revamp Death Valley and Valley of Hell.
[*]Hero Band and Master & Disciple list will be reset.
[*]Infinite Dungeon ranking will be reset, and points will be distributed to the top 50.
[/list]

We'll update this post when the maintenance is complete and servers are available. Additional Patch Notes, including improvements and new features, will be added after the maintenance.

------

[h3]Patch Notes 254 for July 6, 2021
[/h3]The following release notes contain information about the update.

[i]Life and Death (Death Valley and Valley of Hell Renewal)[/i]
[list]
[*]The Choice of Fate and Judgement of Hell now shares the same admission item. The new name for the admission item is called Life and Death. Pass of Life and Death and Pass of Superior Life and Death can be purchase at the Merchant near the dungeon. Pass of Extreme Life and Death can be obtained through the daily quest from The Storyteller, Kong Son-Myeong in Hefei.
[*]You can find full renewal details [URL='https://forums.playredfox.com/index.php?threads/life-and-death-death-valley-and-valley-of-hell.53039/']here[/url].
[/list]

[i]Improvements[/i]
[list]
[*]The modeling of the four Heavenly Costume has been modified with more color patterns.
[*]The maximum damage cap has been raised to 2000000.
[*]An in-game option setting has been added to turn on and off treasure box congratulation messages.
[/list]

[i]Bug Fixes[/i]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue with character name UI overlapping with away text.
[*]An issue with duel advertisement showing your character name instead of the creator has been fixed.
[/list]

 Thank you for your patience during the maintenance.

notes.title: Spirit of Sky Festival
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/6df316cabf3f4f033ca3a1f782dc80a9e6c494a6.jpg[/img]

Welcome to the Spirit of Sky Festival! In this event, we are offering a plethora of daily quests to participate in, in order to farm material items to create a wide variety of useful items guaranteed to improve your gameplay. Log in today and see all that we have to offer!

[h1]Spirit of Sky Gift[/h1]
For the duration of this event, we are giving away Costume Tickets you can trade for 30 Day Golden Dragon, and Red Peony Wardrobes! Press the H key to access the event window to receive yours today!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/9e52711d950afb330b7e22f86d0c3e3cd221d94b.png[/img]

[i]Note: The Spirit of Sky Gift can only be received once per account.
[/i]
[h1]Spirit of Sky's Request Reward[/h1]
You can get 1 Spirit of Sky's Plate once a week per account. A Spirit of Sky's Plate is required when you accept one of the new quests from The Storyteller, Kong Son-Myeong in Hefei or Infinite Master, Man Sangja in Loulan. You can receive a total of four plates during the event period.
[list]
[*]Spirit of Sky's Request Reward 1 - (6/8/2021 - 6/15/2021)
[*]Spirit of Sky's Request Reward 2 - (6/16/2021 - 6/22/2021)
[*]Spirit of Sky's Request Reward 3 - (6/23/2021 - 6/29/2021)
[*]Spirit of Sky's Request Reward 4 - (6/30/2021 - 7/6/2021)
[/list]

[h1]Spirit of Sky Festival Buff[/h1]
Embrace the power of the sky with the following bonuses, which will run for the duration of the event period.
[list]

notes.title: Qingdao 1st Release
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/8e5f4afd6136867578c1edf58f55507814b97a84.png[/img]

Qingdao is a village of night, the town of lust and decadence. The village is under the control of the Black Dragon Clan, so the White and Black clan can not easily unleash their momentum.

When dusk falls in the town, the market street becomes sleepless and chaotic due to merchants, thugs, thieves, and gamblers. Rumor has it that the money and treasure collected from the black market and casino are equivalent to Clan of Golden Coins.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/12b00250ef8b34f7e8ffff0e5b3905c322982f66.png[/img]

The entrance of Qingdao gateway is located in Hefei near the Strolling Valley. There are several NPCs in front of the gate who can provide various information about Qingdao.

Combat is possible in Qingdao and PvP is encouraged. Low ranks should be aware of the invasions from other players.

[b]White Cloud and Black Cloud Basin[/b]
The town is divided into two villages across from a memorial tower called the Ghiryu Tower. Warriors on Black Cloud and White Cloud Basin villages must build up their strength to seize the opposite side.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/4f70b2b384a300505960d1aa42c2a1750523c9e2.png[/img]

[b]Qingdao Deviants[/b]
Emperor Lei, the ruler of the Black Dragons Clan has gone missing. In his wake, the Black Dragon retainers, The Five Heroes From Darkness have free reign to rule over Qingdao. The Five Heroes from Darkness are composed of Magi, the Black Widows Blood, Kwakil, the Shadowless Sword, Hansung, the Flaming Steel Prince, Pyoje, the Hurrican Sword, and Chaewon, the Double-edge Fangs. The strength of deviant evil forces in Qingdao is no joke! Countless warriors came to challenge the deviants in the name of freedom, but none of them have survived to tell the tale.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/7e25c4641d5000fa1e7c6abdcc11644bc8b0e169.png[/img]

[b]Ghiryu Tower[/b]
Ghiryu Tower is the symbol of true warlords. Each floor has vicious and fearsome deviants lie in wait. The gate into Ghiryu Tower will be open sometime in the near future.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/665fede115484a4b8d113b48358d779ec3a341ef.png[/img]

[b]New Road to Enlightenment and Heroic (Daily) Quests[/b]
Talk to Yang Wuqi in Hefei to lead you into your journey to liberating Qingdao from the clutches of the Black Dragons clan and their legion of followers through an assortment of new quests. The villagers need your help and are prepared to reward you handsomely for your efforts!

[b]Create New Items and Increase Your Strength[/b]
Gather material items from helping villagers in quests and slaying members of the Black Dragons Clan to create an assortment of new items that will help you recruit Comrades that will aid you in battle, or build Weapons and Armor to give you the strength to stand over your enemies!

notes.title: Comrade System
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/046c54c1b2046d79f181553045ef220663afdecc.png[/img]

A Comrade is a companion who will fight on your side especially when you are in critical situations. The Comrade system will provide greater support as the level of your Comrade goes up.

As the level of Comrade goes up, you will gain Inner Chi Points. You can choose 1 option from the list of Yin, Yang, Body, Soul, Life, and Vital Energy to increase the stats.

[list]
[*][b]Attack Attribute:[/b] Yin, Yang, Body, or Soul Attack values will be increased.
[*][b]Resistance Attribute:[/b] Yin, Yang, Body, and Soul Resistance values will be increased.
[*][b]Life Transfer:[/b] This will increase your life by transferring a certain amount of Life from your Comrade.
[*][b]Vital Energy Transfer:[/b] Will increase your Vital Energy by transferring a certain amount of Vital Energy from your Comrade.
[/list]

[b]Recruiting a Comrade[/b]
Comrade Recruit system allows you to choose 1 of 6 given Comrades as your companion.
Each of them has a unique story to tell.

You can recruit all 6 but can only have 1 accompany you at a time.

[b]How to Recruit[/b]
[list]
[*]Select 1 comrade from the portraits located on the left side of the window.
[*]Select the favorite item for the Comrade you’d wish to recruit from your inventory on the right side of the Comrade UI.
[*]Right-click to insert the items into the Recruit Comrade UI and click the Recruit button to hire the selected Comrade.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/8a23721cc8451718935908801a3667f89b5461ef.png[/img]

[b]Accompanying with Comrades[/b]
The Comrade system allows you to recruit a partner to travel with. When teaming up with a Comrade, they will not only attack together with you but will share vital energy with you in a tough situation.

Your recruited Comrade will automatically be summoned into battle, but can be switched between recruited Comrades by clicking the Accompany button.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/21e5670a22d8bb5c75fb52759549cce8d53f4848.jpg[/img]


[b]Comrade Information[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/0afc91fc7b5ff5e0cc5a5835d8b9c96ebbf3512c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/7f07bb6709e9c8b6cba0582ee9def839d3aca1b5.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/5858eff6bb9f4ef5904eb88586897246dd1c4026.png[/img]
[/indent]
[b]Comrade Growth[/b]
Comrades can level up by gaining Exp. Exp will be gained by feeding them their favorite items. The more favored the item, the more Exp your Comrade will receive.

[list]
[*]Click the Growth button located at the bottom of the Comrade menu.
[*]Select and register items that your comrade favors from your inventory.
[*]Click the Use button to gain Exp for your Comrade
[/list]
Comrade Growth specialized items should be consumed based on your Comrade's current Rank. Comrade Growth Item (M)~(L) is not recommended to be used until Comrade 26 Rank or higher.

Pure Blue Ointment is extremely rare. If you happen to come across one of these items, be sure not to use it until you are at a really high rank.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/83c1fe80133c7eacaebd15a2d77f3c05b66a4572.jpg[/img]

There are 2 types of items used to gain Inner Chi Points for your Comrade: Soul Pills (S), Soul Pills (L).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/434e2ddd3c83227b79abbcd6e3a9f9ccd7f979c7.jpg[/img]
[b]
Comrade Inner Chi Points[/b]
You will gain Inner Chi Points upon each Comrade level up. The points can be used to increase the stats of the special skills such as Attributes Attack, Attributes Resistance, Life Transfer, and Vital Energy Transfer.

Click Yin Attack, Yang Attack, Body Attack, Soul Attack, Life Transfer, Vital Energy Transfer, Yin Resistance, Yang Resistance, Body Resistance or Soul Resistance buttons to increase the stats of Comrade that you’ve selected.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/54d69b24a21aff50cd235daebb2b5c127a700460.png[/img]
In the case you’ve collected plenty of Inner Chi Points, you can Click the details button and click the + buttons for the Attributes you wish to increase.

[list]
[*]Physical/Chi Kung Damage - Attack Damage of your Comrade
[*]Comrades can specialize in either Physical or Chi Kung Damage.
[*]Attack Speed - Attack Speed of the Comrade
[*]Chance of Special Skill Activation - Special Skill chance of the Comrade
[*]Hands of the Inner Destruction - Amount of internal wounds inflicted to opponent
[*]Life Transfer - Max Life increase of the character
[*]Vital Energy Transfer - Max Vital Energy increase of the character
[*]Yin - Yin Attack / Yin Resistance
[*]Yang - Yang Attack / Yang Resistance
[*]Soul - Soul Attack / Soul Resistance
[*]Body - Body Attack / Body Resistance
[*]Inner Chi Point - Amount of Inner Chi Points held and used
[/list]

[b]Inner Chi Points Reset [/b]
Upon using an item called, 'Oblivion Flower,' all applied Inner Chi Points will reset and able to use again to add their attributes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/f41e3e374f9eb2827f79830f16250b51ed2f6bdf.jpg[/img]

[b]White Brandy[/b]
Consuming White Brandy will increase the number of attacks as well as increase the chance for your Comrade to cast special skills.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/8fabbb4d0cee726970ef8ce674724d4068af302b.png[/img]
[list]
[*]Click the White Brandy button on the recruited Comrade window.
[*]White Brandy Refill: While the White Brandy window is active, select White Brandy from your inventory and click the Use button to recharge.
[*]Click the Activate button to activate the item.
[/list]
White Brandy will be consumed each time your Comrade attacks.

[b]Comrade Achievement[/b]
[SIZE=4]Achievement Rank will be determined after surpassing Comrade Lv99 as listed below:
Comrade Lv99 or lower
Defender (Low) -> Comrade Lv100+
Defender (Mid) -> Comrade Lv200+
Defender (High) -> Comrade Lv300+
Entry Guard -> Comrade Lv400+
Official Guard -> Comrade Lv500+
The Defense Unit (Low) -> Comrade Lv600+
The Defense Unit (Mid) -> Comrade Lv700+
The Master Guard -> Comrade Lv900+[/size]

notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/97fe41c5b950c27c2669fdbbaa819c79b948d01c.png[/img]

It's the season of love! As Valentine's Day rolls around, it's once again time to showcase your creativity in creating a 9Dragons-themed Valentine's Day Card! The creators of the best ten-fifteen cards will win a prize! Dedicate your card to your special Valentine, and that character will win a prize!

Keep in mind that we're looking for the most unique and creative 9Dragons themed V-Day cards. And this means we're looking for more than just a basic screenshot entry. Show your Valentine how important they are by pouring your effort into your cards, for a shot at winning yourselves some great prizes!

You will have until February 22 to submit your Valentine's Day card, so please review the rules and regulations carefully to make sure you qualify.

[b]Prizes[/b]
[list]
[*]Ten - Fifteen (10-15) Winners: Illusive Branch (10)
[*]Special Valentine: Illusive Branch (2)
[/list]
[i]Prizes will be delivered to your character inventory.[/i]
[b]
Contest Format[/b]
Please use this form when submitting
[list]
[*]Character & Server Name: (Your character and server name)
[*]Special Valentine Character & Server Name: (Your friend character and server name)
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/59b69a1dd470e6912d36377f90a427adbd7d13e9.png[/img]

[b]Rules & Restrictions:[/b]
[list]
[*]Participants must submit their entry by replying to this official Contest thread.
[*]Participants can submit a maximum of one entry per account.
[*]Entries cannot contain any copyrighted material with the only exception to material copyrighted by RedFox Games & 9Dragons.
[*]Entries cannot contain any material that violates the 9Dragons Forum Code of Conduct or Terms of Service.
[*]Using multiple accounts to submit additional entries on the 9Dragons forums is prohibited. Anyone found using multiple accounts will be disqualified.
[*]Winners will be determined by the subjective judgment of the 9Dragons team.
[*]Each winner will receive a prize for two. One from themselves and one to their friend.
[*]The contest entry period begins at 6:00 PM PST February 8 and ends at 6:00 PM PST February 22. Winners will be announced on February 25.
[*]Keep the thread clean; off-topic will be deleted.
[/list]

notes.notes:

[h1]New Year’s Gift[/h1]
As a welcome to the new year, we are giving away a [New Year Event] Clothes Exchange Ticket, which can be exchanged for a 30 day Bull Costume or 30-day Cow Costume.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/bb91ce15455cf4bac0b93ae5f121079e861cc280.png[/img]

[list]
[*]Increases Refinement Success Rate by 25%
[*]Increases Create Chance by 50%
[*]Increases Attack Speed by 34.0%
[*]Reduces Kung Fu Cooldown/Recast time by 15.0%
[*]Increases Movement Speed by 100%
[/list]

notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/ccc32c5a417772f1b6ade1fdb2cb0b8cb9aa8fe8.jpg[/img]

Have a holly jolly Christmas! In case you didn't hear, we will be celebrating this holiday season with a wonderful assortment of Christmas Events! In addition to gifts, you can participate in a Christmas Daily Quest and exchange event resources with Santa for items that are sure to bring in the holiday cheer! Don't miss out on your chance to partake in all the festivities!

[h1]Christmas Gift[/h1]
To celebrate the holiday season, we are giving away a 30-day Christmas Red Costume, as well as a 30-day Christmas Red Amulet relic and Christmas Past Memories relic, which can be upgraded to permanent relics via Santa's Create List!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/a44c4a023e7f10121dce0f1cce01d49888cd9914.png[/img]

[h1]Christmas Daily Quest[/h1]
Each day, Santa will offer you a quest in which you simply receive a free Christmas Santa Box when you log into the game! This quest can be received once a day for each character.

[i]Christmas Gift contains one of the following items.[/i]
[list]
[*]Christmas Santa Box
[*]Santa's Excellent Candy
[*]Santa's Good Candy
[*]Santa's Candy
[/list]

[list]
[*]Increases Life/Vital Energy by 15000
[*]Absorb Life and Vital Energy by 20/1000
[*]Increase All Attributes by 150
[/list]
The Christmas with Snow Buff will last for 360 minutes. When the buff expires, you can relog to receive the buff again.

Tree Branches drop from field mobs over level 150, and Christmas Lights drop from Dungeon mobs over level 150. Bring as many of these items as you can to Santa, and he will reward you with early presents.

notes.title: Update: Hainan Island
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/46175e37537a4620d4a4ebb870ac332f13380349.png[/img]

[h1]Swords of the Dragon Warlord - The Book of White Dragon Spirits[/h1]
For the past few decades, a great number of skilled warriors have been in search of 2 legendary artifacts called, [i]Nine Dragon Jade Circle[/i] and [i]Swords of the Dragon Warlords[/i], scouring the land, whenever a clue presents itself.

During their never-ending journey, many warriors from various clans have learned and improved their kung-fu skills exponentially by defeating evil deviants and members of the rival clans in their way.

The legend of the [i]Swords of The Dragon Warlords[/i] is proven by renowned archaeologists over numerous years showing evidence that this artifact is more than just a myth.

The legendary [i]Nine Dragon Jade Circle[/i] was an accessory, which belonged to the Thunder Emperor, a great legendary warrior. He carved his ultimate kung-fu techniques on the surface of a circle accessory and scattered it's 9 pieces before heading out to the final battle of the War of Nine Dragons.

On the other hand, the tale of the [i]Swords of the Dragon Warlords[/i] tells of how the swords were magically forged using 5 sacred elements, and the spirits of 5 Dragons sealed within. According to legend, those who acquire all 5 swords shall unlock the secret passage of the Treasure of the Dragon Warlord, which is has been said to be the key to achieve the status of [i]Overlord of the Mighty Dragons[/i].

The Thunder Emperor had the chance to gain the [i]Black Dragon Warlord Sword[/i], one of the 5 legendary swords, and has achieved Super Metamorphosis, leaving a bloodbath in his wake.

After countless years of searching, a secret room has been discovered in Potala Palace, during their most recent clan battle. What was so important in about the tiny room, that it had been sealed for decades? Even the elders and high councils of the palace had no idea of its existence. Within the dusty room lay nothing, but an old bookshelf containing the legendary [i]Book of White Dragon Spirits[/i]. This was one of the greatest discoveries of the century, proving the story of the [i]Swords of the Dragon Warlords[/i] was more than just an ancient myth.

Without hesitation, the leaders of well-established clans rushed to Potala Palace in Tibet, in order to conduct an expedition to unlock and obtain the secrets of the [i]Book of White Dragon Spirits[/i]. Countless souls perished during their investigation, but nothing could stop them from acquiring the precious book, as they paved the roads to Potala Palace with blood.

The strongest 6 clans were no exception but realized that the battle over the legendary artifacts must be halted before any further expeditions could be conducted. Ultimately, the leaders of the 6 clans had an official meeting and came to an agreement to forge 6 copies of the [i]Book of White Dragon Spirits[/i], to be passed down to the successors of each clan head, putting an end to the surrounding chaos.

After the forgeries of the [i]Book of White Dragon Spirits[/i] were handed to the leader of each clan, leading scholars and archaeologists are gathered to decode the ancient text and reveal the path to become the [i]Overlord of the Mighty Dragons[/i].

The decoding process was a very tedious and complicated process, uncovering the meaning of only 3 sentences thus far:

[b]Crimson Fog[/b]
[i]"Everywhere is filled with blood, smoke, fog, and corpses..."[/i]

[b]Scattering Souls[/b]
[i]"Difficult to perform techniques by scattering one's vital energy."[/i]

[b]Silent Fortress[/b]
[i]"There is no safe zone due to the surrounding delicate formations."[/i]

[h1]Hainan Location[/h1]
Hainan Island is located on the southern edge of China.
You can move only if you have an item called Hainan Teleport Scroll, which will teleport you to a random spot on the island.
You can acquire the scroll from the Hainan Survivor, Masked Man in Hefei.
The only way to leave the island is to ride on a boat at the shoreline to Liaodong. However, please notice that once you leave, you will have to use another Hainan Teleport Scroll to return.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/87331ac3ea592a663d1aaa67cbc440f643465c95.jpg[/img]

[b]Character Restrictions in Hainan[/b]
[LIST=1]
[*]No Parties or Raid Parties
[*]Unable to move while in Penalty Status
[*]Unable to move to other areas while in dungeon
[*]Unable to move by using any type of Summon abilities
[*]Unable to move while in battle
[/list]

[h1]Hainan Function[/h1]
[i]No Allies on the Island. Kill or be Killed.[/i]
[list]
[*]No chat function is allowed except whisper.
[*]Excluding Kung-Fu Skills, all other features, including weapons, clothes, accessories, and graphical effects will be disabled.
[*]There will only be 2 types of character appearance based on their gender. (as shown in the image below)
[*]The names of other characters on the island will appear as masked to hide their identities.
[*]No Party, Master & Disciple, Hero Band, or Hero League is allowed. Remember, it is kill or be killed.
[*]PvP results on the island will not be affected on your Combat record.
[*]You cannot select to see the info of other characters.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/89f7437d4ae50bbe9d0007f30b61b17767725644.png[/img]

[i]Mighty Traps and Secret Formation of the Hainan Island[/i]

[*]Click "Hainan Island" on the world map to see further details.

notes.title: Contest: The Notorious PIG
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/f22b78a032df2406ddffaf06f02425e01c505bbc.png[/img]

Rumor has it that a group of brigands in Golden Pig Costumes have been ransacking villages all across the land. In order to capture these thieves, we need your help to identify them. In this contest, you will take a screenshot in your Golden Pig Costume, and make a wanted poster.

You have until May 26 to submit your entry, but please take a moment to read through the Rules and Restrictions to see how to submit them. Winners will be announced on June 1. Good Luck!


[b]How to Participate:[/b]
[list]
[*]Take a screenshot of your character in a Golden Pig Costume. Press F5 to hide the UI
[*]Create a wanted poster using your screenshot. If you would like, you can use one of the many Wanted Poster Templates available online.
[*]Post your wanted poster as a reply to this post and make sure to include the name of your character and server name. Entries are limited to one per player.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/a7ca4eddcad56069358c032bcf58d583f767371b.png[/img]

[b]Prizes:[/b]
[list]
[*]1st Prize: 1 randomly selected winners: Blue Dragon's Treasure Box (30)
[*]2nd Prize: 5 randomly selected winners base on submission: Blue Dragon's Treasure Box (10)
[*]3rd Prize: 20 randomly selected winners base on submission: Blue Dragon's Treasure Box (5)
[/list]

[b]Rules and Restrictions:[/b]
[list]
[*]The contest entry period begins on May 13, 2020, and ends on May 26, 2020, at 18:00 PDT. Winners will be announced on June 1, 2020.
[*]The reward distribution time is tentative and subject to change.
[*]Participants must submit their entry by replying to this official contest thread.
[*]Prizes will be granted to the posting account and is non-transferrable to a different account.
[*]Entries cannot contain any copyrighted material with the only exception to material copyrighted by RedFox Games & Nine Dragons Awaken.
[*]Entries cannot contain any material that violates Forum Code of Conduct or Terms of Service.
[*]Winners will be determined by the subjective judgement of the 9Dragons team.
[*]Using multiple accounts to submit additional entries on the 9Dragons forums is prohibited. Anyone found using multiple accounts will be disqualified.
[*]Keep the thread clean; off-topic will be deleted.
[/list]
[b]
[/b]

notes.title: Event: Spring Golden Pig
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/8bc5404acd804582a20674d66c917e355b80f284.png[/img]

April showers and May flowers! As this season begins to bloom, we have prepared a bouquet of events to help spring you forward on your journey. Now is your chance to earn luxurious costumes and Golden Pig Guardians to accompany you along the way to a fortune!

[h1]Golden Pig Buff[/h1]
In Celebration of the warmth of Spring and the blooming of flowers, we're activating the following bonuses, which will run for the duration of the event period.
[list]
[*]Increase Maximum Life 10000
[*]Increase Maximum Vital Energy 10000
[*]Absorb Damage into Life by 20/100
[*]Increase Attack Speed by 30%
[/list]
The Golden Pig Buff will last for 359 minutes. When the buff expires you can relog to receive the buff again.

[h1]Year of the Pig Golden Pig Costumes[/h1]
From now until the end of the event you can purchase Golden Pig Costumes (1 Day) from Festival Merchant Jiang Daxi for 2,200,000 Gold. Try your luck and use them to create their permanent versions, the infamous [Year of the Pig] Golden Pig Costumes!

[h1]Collect Golden Pig Resources[/h1]
As the weather warms up for spring, the dragons take to the land, leaving Gold Nuggets and Gold Pipes in their trails. Collect as many as you can and bring them to Hefei's festival merchant Jiang Daxi for an assortment of rewards, guaranteed to take you further. Gold Nuggets can be found by defeating field mobs over level 150, and Gold Pipes can be found by defeating dungeon mobs over level 150.

notes.title: Event: 4th Anniversary Celebration
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/2d415e4aed8e12cd24dfdd8682ade10cab092e8d.png[/img]

It's been a long time coming, but here we are! We would like to thank everyone who has supported Nine Dragons through its trials and tribulations that have helped to shape what the game is today. In celebration of the passing years, we are happy to host a number of great events that any dragon can appreciate!

[h1]4th Anniversary Gift[/h1]
Start the 4th Anniversary Celebration with a bang, claiming a 4th Anniversary Gift Box by clicking the gift box icon on your screen, or pressing the (H) key. Make sure not to miss out on this limited-time chance to receive a [Rank 4] Guardian Spirit simply for logging into the game! Opportunities like this just don't happen, so gather your friends to take part in this event! 4th Anniversary Gift Boxes are limited to one per account.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/a5f90aaadb3eabdd5fae181c2770006cc8713e0d.png[/img]

[h1]4th Anniversary Buff[/h1]
In celebration of our 4th year anniversary, we're activating the following bonuses, which will run for the duration of the event period.
[list]
[*]Increases Maximum Life by 15000
[*]Increases Maximum Vital Energy by 2500
[*]Increases Critical Hit Chance by 2500/10000
[*]Increases Critical Hit Damage by 25%
[*]Increases All Attributes by 15
[/list]
The 4th Anniversary buff will last for 359 minutes. When the buff expires, you can relog to receive the buff again.

[h1]4th Anniversary Playtime Bonus[/h1]
Each day you log in, make sure to click your "Stamp Tracker" icon located below the mini-map in the game to receive your reward(s). The longer you stay logged in, the more rewards you receive! Log in for the below cumulative periods of time during the event period to receive 4th Anniversary Silver Coins, and 4th Anniversary Gold Coins!

[indent][ATTACH=full]30795[/attach][/indent]
[list]
[*]Click the “Stamp Tracker” icon located below the mini-map in the game to display the Accumulated Event.
[*]You must achieve a cumulative amount of minutes/hours over the event period logged in to receive the event prizes.
[*]The prizes are cumulative. If you qualified for a higher tier of Playtime rewards, you would also receive all lower tiers.
[*]Prizes are limited to once per account.
[/list]

[h1]Collect 4th Anniversary Coins[/h1]
As the 4th-anniversary event rages on, the land has been littered with gold and silver coins. Collect as many as you can and bring them to Hefei's festival merchant Jiang Daxi for an assortment of rewards, guaranteed to take you further. 4th Anniversary Silver Coins can be found by defeating field mobs over level 150, and 4th Anniversary Gold Coins can be found by defeating dungeon mobs over level 150.

notes.title: Event: Lunar New Year 2020
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/620984bfa7e54e41b22307c71ad56febec096959.png[/img]

Happy Lunar New Year! Are you ready to claim all the fortune and prosperity this year has to offer? In celebration of the Year of the Rat, we are hosting events that are sure to put you ahead of the curve.

[h1]Collect White Rat Tails and Fangs![/h1]
The tails and fangs of the mythical White Rat have been scattered all across the land. As these items are held with high regard, you can trade them into Hefei's festival merchant, Seo Hwarang, for a chance to create some priceless relics. White Rat Fangs can be found by defeating field mobs over level 150, and White Rat Tails can be found by defeating dungeon mobs over level 150. Collect as many as you can and amass great power for the new year.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/0c6c62dceb413679ce56c0d68176096b6b3ede0a.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/55d118f9cfdecb8e8ab1e8a8a75d7a98a63995bc.png[/img]

Imbued with the power of the mythical White Rat, take charge of the new year with the support of the Chi of the White Rat Buff. During the event period, we will be activating the following bonuses!
[list]
[*]Increases Maximum Life by 15000
[*]Increases Maximum Vital Energy by 15000
[*]Absorb Damage and Vital energy by 10/1000
[*]Increases all Attributes by 30
[/list]
The Chi of the White Rat buff will last for 359 minutes. When the buff expires, you can relog to receive the buff again.

Every day you log in, during this event period, be sure to click on the "Stamp Tracker" icon, located below the mini-map in-game to receive your reward(s). notes.notes:

[h1]How to Participate:[/h1]
[list=1]

Note: If you do not have any editing software, you can use this free website: [url]https://bighugelabs.com/deck.php[/url]

[b]Contest Format[/b]
Please use this format when submitting
[list]
[*]Character Name: (Your character name)

[/list]

[h1]Prizes:[/h1]

Search through dungeons for signs of the guardians who seek you! For the duration of the event, gather as many Trace of Guardian as possible by defeating mobs over level 150 in the following dungeons.
[LIST]
[*]Purple Dungeon: The School of Rising Sun, Icy Dungeon, Black Temple, and Potala Fortress.
[*]Green Dungeon: Valley of Hell, Mansion of Silver Coins, Wild Tower, Beast Tower, Mansion of Gold Coins, School of Rising Sun, Icy Dungeon, Black Temple, and Potala Fortress.
[*]Red Dungeon: Death Valley, Valley of Hell, Mansion of Silver Coins, Wild Tower, Beast Tower, Mansion of Golden Coins, The School of Rising Sun, Icy Dungeon, Black Temple, and Potala Fortress.
[/LIST]

[I]Oh, Minyoung’s Mystical Creature Box[/I]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27673923/2349222543e94fe82023bf87c2526c1fcf4ed291.png[/img]

[h1]Playtime Bonus[/h1]
Each day you log in, make sure to click your “Stamp Tracker” icon located below the mini-map in the game to receive your reward(s). The longer you stayed logged in, the more rewards you receive! Log in for the below cumulative periods of time over the event periods to receive Soul Stone Shards, [Rank 3] Lost Soul Pouch, Wandering Soul, Soul Stone, and a [Rank 1] Spirit of Guardian!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27673923/32b87858eef32961ce75f68def88f9e67deb7a78.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27673923/b76f9b7cd62d168788e215ca459803ceb6081d01.png[/img]

[LIST]

[*]We will not be compensating for any rewards not received due to the start time of our Accumulated Event.
[*]Prizes are limited to once per account.
[/LIST]

[h1]Marketplace Item: Guardian Commemoration Boxes[/h1]
From now until 6:00 PM, July 29, you'll be able to purchase one of the Guardian Commemoration Boxes from our Marketplace! Read on for the full details of this special, limited time sale!

Hello, Dragons,

The servers will undergo maintenance and server update on Tuesday (02/12) starting at 18:00 server time. The downtime will be approximately 4 hours.

[b]Reason:[/b]
[LIST]
[*]Routine server checks

We'll update this post when the maintenance is complete, and servers are available. Additional Patch Notes including improvements and new features will be added after the maintenance.

Thank you for your patience during the maintenance.

===============

[h1]Patch Notes 159 for February 12, 2019[/h1]
The following release notes contain information about the update.

[B]Storm vs. Storm Update[/B]
Storm vs. Storm (SvS) is a power struggle between Hero Bands that occur every week, where players attempt to capture Stone Pillars to gain rewards.

The first battle will begin on Saturday, February 16, 2019, at 9:00 AM PST.

[I]Starting Storm vs. Storm[/I]
[LIST]
[*]Locate the Storm vs. Storm menu by accessing the SvS tab of the F11 menu.
[*]Storm vs. Storm will only be held at the Fortress of Majesty in Hangzhou.
[*]Only the Band Master can request and cancel the SvS Challenge. Up to 50 Hero Bands can participate per one SvS.
[*]SvS Registration Period: Between the end of the previous battle and one week before the next one begins. (Unable to register once the SvS has already started.)
[*]The "Waiting Area" button will automatically appear 30 minutes before the start of the upcoming Storm vs. Storm. "Waiting Area" button can be found in the F11menu → Storm vs. Storm tab. Click the button to move to the Fortress waiting area. The function is available until the end of Storm vs. Storm.
[*]Health Potions, Huatuo Panacea, and Lightfoot are prohibited during the battle. Recovery skills, continuous recovery potions, and Siphon Panacea can be used.
[*]There is no death or combat penalty, and you are allowed to attack members from the same clan.
[/LIST]
[I]Storm vs. Storm Progress[/I]
[LIST]
[*]At the beginning of Storm vs. Storm, all Stone Pillars located in the Fortress are uncaptured and ready to occupied. A total of 10 Stone Pillars protected by Fortress Guard DNPCs
[*]Deviants will appear a total of 10 times to protect each Stone Pillar.  As time goes by, more powerful deviants will emerge, so it is recommended to defeat them.
[*]Characters who died during Storm vs. Storm can revive back to the waiting area with Impervious time effect of 30 seconds. The Impervious time effect is reduced when you use the Pillar to teleport.
[/LIST]
[I]Storm vs. Storm Rewards[/I]
[LIST]
[*]The Hero Band with the most amount of Stone Pillar occupied will be declared as Lord of the Fortress and will receive trade/sell taxes on all items in Zhengzhou, Shi Zhang, Jinan, Datong, Nanchang, Tibet, Hangzhou, Liaodong, Hefei, The Cave of the Conqueror, Loulan, North Sea, and Kunlun.
[*]The tax rate gain is base on how many Stone Pillar captured. (1 Stone Pillar = 10% Tax Rate)
[*]The tax rate accumulation will begin from the time of the end of SvS and can only be withdrawn by the Hero Band Master.
[/LIST]
[B]Ended Lunar New Year Event[/B]
[LIST]
[*]Removed 2019 letters from dungeon drops.
[*]Removed Lunar New Year content from the Festival Merchant, Seo Hwarang NPC resource and trade list.
[*]The Golden Pig Summoning Spirit sale has ended.
*]Removed winter themed decoration in Hefei Marketplace.
[/LIST]
[B]Black vs. White War[/B]
Black vs. White war schedule has changed. The new schedule is every Thursday at 20:00 and Sunday at 11:00 server time.

[B]Bug Fixes[/B]
[LIST]
[*]Fixed an exploit where the same type relic can be equipped simultaneously.
[*]Fixed an issue where skills cannot be used after being revived by a party member.
[*]Fixed an issue where skills can gain experience points while attacking stands.
[*]Fixed a bug where the healer formation skill cooldown can be canceled.
[*]Fixed the description of Blood Mushroom skill on Blood Sorcerer Crimson weapons.
[*]Abnormal transition progress through data exchange during client execution is corrected.
[/LIST]
[B]Improvements[/B]
[LIST]
[*]Improved the Character (C) window where it closes while character bag is open.
[*]Stats tooltip between Character (C) window and Character summary window is now the same.
[/LIST]
[B]Miscellaneous[/B]
[LIST]
[*]The Hero Band and Master & Disciple list have been reset.
[*]Infinite Dungeon ranking have been reset, and points distributed to the top 50.
[/LIST]

notes.title: New Event Server: Yang Opens Aug 22!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27673923/685e04a56c4f90b947eab63591573ceb453602ca.png[/img]

Dear Dragons,

We are pleased to announce that 9Dragons will be launching our first event server on August 21, 2018! This is a perfect opportunity for players who want a fresh start or to play on equal footing from the very beginning of the adventure. Mark your calendars and keep an eye on our announcement, as we will keep you all updated with additional details closer to the launch date.

[h1]Launch Date:[/h1]
August 21, 2018 after server maintenance

[h1]Server Rates:[/h1]
3x Exp, 4x Skill, 4x Drop

The new event server Yang will be merged into Yin server at the end of Season 1. All players participating in the new server must either have an account or create a NEW RedFox Games account with no characters on Tao or Yin server to qualify for a server merge after the event.

=====

[h1]New Event Server FAQ[/h1]
Please review the important FAQ below.

[B]What is an Event server?[/B]
Event server is a booster server that is brought online designed to give players a clean slate to play on equal footing from the very beginning of the adventurer.

[B]What is the name of the new Event server?[/B]
The new Event server will be named Yang.

[B]When does the Event server launch?[/B]
The server officially opens on August 21, 2018.

[B]Will I be able to transfer my existing characters on this Event server?[/B]
No – any existing character will be unable to transfer to the event server.

[B]Can I use my prior account to access this server?[/B]
Yes – you can use your existing account to access the Event server. However, to qualify for the transfer at the end of Season 1, you must have no characters on both Yin and Tao server.

[B]What is the name of the server my character will be transfer to at the end of Season 1?[/B]
At the end of Season 1, all characters from the Event server will be transfer into Yin server.

[B]What will not be transferred and be reset at the end of Season 1?[/B]
The following information will be initialized and will not be transferred:
[LIST]
[*]Hero Band
[*]Friend List
[*]Master & Disciple
[*]Carrier Pigeon Inbox
[*]Loulan PvP Record
[*]Combat Record
[*]Server Ranking Data
[*]Black vs. White War
[*]Duel PvP Record
[*]Hero Tournament
[*]SvS
[*]Loyalty
[*]Items and gold stored in the Warehouse/Quest Storage will NOT be transferred.
[*]Items stored in the Purchase Inventory(Cart, Gift, and Cart (Web) will NOT be transferred.
[*]Items and gold stored in the Auction House will NOT be transferred.
[/LIST]

[B]Will the RedFox Games Marketplace be any different in the Event server? [/B]
No. The Marketplace will have the same items as Yin and Tao server.

Hello, Dragons,

The servers will undergo maintenance and server update on Tuesday (08/21) starting at 18:00 server time. The downtime will be approximately 8-10 hours.

[h1]Reasons:[/h1]
[LIST]
[*]Routine server checks
[*]Add New Event Server "Yang"
[*]End Summer Event
[LIST]

[/LIST]

[/LIST]

Thank you for your patience during the maintenance.

In battle, martial artists carry their weapons as extensions of their own warrior spirit. In some cases, these weapons gain fame, honor, and notoriety, often giving them names. This is a creative event, where players will display their weapons, and tell us about their weapon’s name and the reason behind it.

[h1]HOW TO ENTER:[/h1]

[*]Give your weapon a unique name.
[*]Explain why you have given your weapon that name.

notes.title: Accessory Slot Expansion
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27673923/9b9c5aef0f18e8f3f6342052e74f2916793ba8b3.png[/img]

Wish you had slots for all of your accessories? Here’s an expansion you can really appreciate. In this update, we are introducing 8 additional accessory slots you can unlock through either in-game gold, depending on your character level, or through cash shop items!

You can access and unlock the expanded Accessory Slots via character window by pressing the "C" key.

[B]Level Accessory Slots[/B]
[LIST]
[*]There are four Level Accessory Slots you can open by using in-game gold.
[*]The slots you can unlock will be dependent on your current character level.
[LIST]
[*]Lvl 220 - 100,000,000 Gold
[*]Lvl 242 - 1,000,000,000 Gold
[*]Lvl 246 - 2,000,000,000 Gold
[*]Lvl 250 - 3,000,000,000 Gold
[/LIST]

[*]Cash Item Slot 1 - Crouching Dragon Jade
[*]Cash Item Slot 2 - Black Dragon Jade (Crimson Treasure Chest)
[*]Cash Item Slot 3 - Sleeping Dragon Jade (Crimson Treasure Chest)

[/LIST]

Note:[/B]
[LIST]

notes.title: Contest: Video Guide Specialist
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27673923/dae0a0afb09c22915c71d0f43c5fde308365d8d6.png[/img]

Do you like to make video guides for games? Take this opportunity to get rewarded for your work by creating a Nine Dragons Awaken video guide, and submitting your video in our Video Guide Specialist Contest!

Although the video guide subject is entirely up to you, here are some subjects we are looking for:
[LIST]
[*]Any of our updates, or renewals
[*]Beginner to advanced leveling
[*]Beginner to advanced farming
[*]Dungeons
[*]Class and Role specific
[*]Crafting
[*]Refinement
[*]Questline
[*]etc.
[/LIST]

[B]HOW TO ENTER:[/B]
[LIST]
[*]Create a video guide of your choice and upload it to Youtube.com.
[*]Post a link of your video in response to this [url=http://forums.playredfox.com/index.php?threads/contest-video-guide-specialist.41696/]thread.[/url] 
[*]Please read the contest rules for more information
[/LIST]

[B]PRIZES:[/B]

1st - 15,000 RedFox Credits (1 winner)
2nd - 7,500 RedFox Credits (2 winners)
3rd - 5,000 RedFox Credits (2 winners)


[B]RULES:[/B]
[LIST]
[*]Contest begins March 16th, 2018, and ends at 6PM PDT on April 6th, 2018
[*]Prizes will be awarded to the account the entry is posted on.
[*]All videos must be uploaded to YouTube and listed as Public.
After uploading your video to YouTube, post the link in this [url=http://forums.playredfox.com/index.php?threads/contest-video-guide-specialist.41696/]thread.[/url]
[*]All video titles must have the following format: [9Dragons Awaken] Video Guide Specialist + “Subject of your guide”
[*]The video description must contain:
[LIST]
[*]Your forum name
[*]Short description of your guide
[*]The game’s website: [URL]https://www.playredfox.com/nine_dragons[/URL]
[/LIST]
[*]Video must include both RedFox Games and Nine Dragons Awaken logos which can be found in the [url=http://forums.playredfox.com/index.php?threads/contest-video-guide-specialist.41696/]Video Guide Specialist[/url]  forum page.
[*]The contest winners must provide raw assets and final cut video to be eligible to receive rewards.
[*]The style of the video is open (e.g. animation, text-based, image-based, facecam-based, mixed, etc.)
[*]Special effects may be used, but should not overshadow the video’s content.
[*]You may use in the video, any information available to the Nine Dragons Awaken community (e.g. Website, Forums, etc.)
[*]Your video must not include any copyrighted music or content.
[*]Post must include the in-game character name chosen for the contest.
[*]Prizes will be granted as-is; no substitutions will be offered.
[*]Winners will be selected under the following criteria:
[LIST]
[*]Video Quality
[*]Helpfulness
[*]Regardless of the amount of participating users, if none of the video entries meet our standards in terms of video quality or helpfulness, no winners will be selected.
[/LIST]
[*]All contest decisions are at the discretion of Red Fox Games and are final.
[/LIST]

*To be considered eligible to win prizes, all rules must be followed. By breaking any of the rules, you'll be disqualified from the event.

notes.title: Event: 2nd Year Anniversary Celebration
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27673923/ad6ed41bbb1aec9d799c0164eb07026348451627.png[/img]

Can you believe it? Nine Dragons Awaken has been officially online for 2 years! We would like to extend our gratitude for joining us on this journey. We will continue to strive to bring the best gaming experience to all for many more years to come. Let’s all celebrate this momentous occasion with the 2nd Year Anniversary Event!

[h1]2nd Year Anniversary Playtime Bonus[/h1]
Each day you log in, make sure to click your “Stamp Tracker” icon located below the mini-map in the game to receive your reward(s). The longer you stayed logged in, the more rewards you receive! Log in for the below cumulative periods of time over the event periods to receive Golden Pig!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27673923/0cae6693ebef07f1da33383af94b3501f612416a.png[/img]

[LIST]
[*]Click the “Stamp Tracker” icon located below the mini-map in the game to display the Accumulated Event.

[*]You must achieve a cumulative amount of minutes/hours over the event period logged in to receive the event prizes.
[*]The prizes are cumulative. If you qualified for a higher tier of Playtime rewards, you would also receive all lower tiers.
[*]Prizes are limited to once per account.
[/LIST]

[h1]Find the Golden Pig[/h1]
Golden Pigs have been added to The Land. Once you find a Golden Pig, kill it to obtain Gold Pig for a Golden Egg!
[LIST]
[*]Golden Pigs will appear in the field maps excluding Clan Base, Bamboo Village, Hefei, and Kunlun.
[*]Golden Pigs will drop either Lucky Golden Coins and/or Gold Pig.
[*]Obtain more Gold Pigs by hunting Golden Pigs in Loulan.
[*]Golden Pigs replaces Lucky Golden Boxes for the duration of the event
[/LIST]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27673923/8131d70cab60138f8e21fbbaedcec23a105841bd.png[/img]

[B]Golden Egg contains one of the following items:[/B]
[LIST]
[*]Flamed Soul Box
[*]Frozen Soul Box
[*]Golden Coin Piece
[*]Gold Pig
[*]Ancient Golden Compass
[*]Ancient Silver Compass
[*]Flag of Chaos
[*]Rising Bead of Kylin
[*]Golden 9Dragons Box
[LIST]
[*]1,000,000
[*]5,000,000
[*]10,000,000
[*]25,000,000
[*]50,000,000
[/LIST]
[/LIST]
So what are you waiting for? Jump in today and earn some of these awesome prizes as we celebrate our 2nd year of Nine Dragons!

[h1]2nd Year Anniversary OX Quiz[/h1]
OX Quiz will begin every Saturday during the event period. Visit the Dragon's Cave (OX Quiz Zone) to start your path to the upcoming quiz battle! Please refer to the [URL='http://forums.playredfox.com/index.php?threads/ox-quiz-introduction.6106/']OX Quiz Introduction[/URL] post [URL='http://forums.playredfox.com/index.php?threads/ox-quiz-introduction.6106/'][I]here[/I][/URL].

[B]Event Schedule: [/B]
[LIST]
[*]3/10 Saturday at 8:00
[*]3/17 Saturday at 19:00
[*]3/24 Saturday at 8:00
[*]3/31 Saturday at 19:00
[/LIST]
We encourage everyone to participate in the OX Quiz event. Even if you don't win, you'll still get a reward for participating! Join in all four OX Quiz battle to receive four different colors "[B]Quiz Battle Token[/B]", which can be traded in for ten "Golden Egg".
[LIST]
[*][B]Four lucky winners[/B] will receive either a [B]Demon-faced Soul Plate[/B], [B]Demon-faced Risen Plate[/B], [B]God of Wind[/B], or a [B]God of Rain[/B].
[*]Receive one Golden Egg, three Special Sweet Cake, and five Huato's Pancea when you answer all questions correctly.
[*]Receive three Special Sweet Bread and two Experience Bonus Card when you answer more than eight questions correctly.
[*]Receive three Special Sweet Cake and Quiz Battle Token when you participate!
[*]Receive Glory of the Clan Buff (Attributes increased by 25, Movement Speed doubled, attack rate increased by 500 for 30 mins) when the event ends.
[/LIST]

[h1]Marketplace Item: Golden Pig[/h1]
From now until 6:00 PM, April 3rd, you'll be able to also purchase the Golden Egg from our Marketplace!
[LIST]
[*]Golden Egg (15+4) + Exchanged Coupon Epithet(30 Days)
[*]Golden (5+1)
[*]Golden Egg (1)
[/LIST]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27673923/fdafbfb0a82814c73455ca120433a0fa0cb12414.png[/img]

[B]Notes:[/B]
[LIST]
[*]The event schedule and details are subject to change without notice or compensation
[*]Click the [?] icon located at the top-right corner to open up the Resource and Create window.
[*]Hoover over the magnifying glass to check the properties of the item.
[*]Reward items are obtained at a fixed probability -- there is no guarantee that you will obtain them.
[*]Golden Pig Event will end on March 27th's maintenance.
[*]Event items and Resource list will be deleted from the game. Be certain to use/open them by [strike]April 3rd's[/strike] (TBA) maintenance.
[/LIST]

notes.title: Update: Costume Gallery
notes.notes:
In this update, you will be able to register Costumes into your Costume Gallery, which can be accessed via F11, where you can change, unequip, and add additional stats to all of your Costumes.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27673923/1b64fb6b853df2e1c6ba5acd910a63780938977c.png[/img]

[h1][B]Costume Gallery Registration[/B][/h1]
[LIST]
[*]In order to register a Costume into your Costume Gallery, you will need to purchase slots using in-game gold.
[*]You can purchase a maximum of 6 Gallery slots using gold, then for slots 7 through 50, you will need to use Costume Slot Ticket, which can be purchased in our Marketplace.
[*]To Register a Costume, simply right click on the Costume you wish to register in your inventory.
[*]The icon for the selected deco will appear in the Costume Registration and Extraction section.
[*]Upon clicking the Register button, you will be asked to confirm registration of your Costume into the Costume Gallery.
[*]Keep in mind that once you register a Costume, it will be deleted from your inventory and will be permanently registered.
[*]Additionally, timed Costumes cannot be registered to your Costume Gallery.
[/LIST]
[h1][B]Cost of Costume Gallery Slots[/B][/h1]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27673923/8524403cd1991e9df42db7daabad5a93511f348e.png[/img]

[h1][B]Potential Abilities and Extraction[/B][/h1]
[LIST]
[*]In the Costume Gallery system, you will be able to add Potential Abilities, or stats, to your Costume, by clicking on the Fabric icon in the Ability section.
[*]Ability slots are ranked 1 - 5 with the first slot being Rank 1, and the last slot being Rank 5.
[*]To unlock Ability slots, you will need to use Fabrics, which can be gained through Costume Extraction, by right clicking a Costume in your Inventory and clicking the Extract button in the Costume Registration and Extraction section of your Costume Gallery UI.
[*]Keep in mind that Clan, timed, or opposite gender Costumes cannot be entered for Extraction.
[/LIST]
[h1][B]Fabric Cost for Potential Ability Ranks[/B][/h1]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27673923/1ff2cd0c369debf89d6c5699dd0aba8b39b2b55e.png[/img]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27673923/826188f57be3aeace6ec18fd8e6e053dfa0bf703.png[/img]

[*]In order to register a Costume into your Costume Gallery, you will need to purchase slots using in-game gold.
[*]You can purchase a maximum of 6 Gallery slots using gold, then for slots 7 through 50, you will need to use Costume Slot Ticket, which can be purchased in our Marketplace.
[*]To Register a Costume, simply right click on the Costume you wish to register in your inventory.
[*]The icon for the selected deco will appear in the Costume Registration and Extraction section.
[*]Upon clicking the Register button, you will be asked to confirm registration of your Costume into the Costume Gallery.
[*]Keep in mind that once you register a Costume, it will be deleted from your inventory and will be permanently registered.
[*]Additionally, timed Costumes cannot be registered to your Costume Gallery.
[/LIST]
[h1][B]Cost of Costume Gallery Slots[/B][/h1]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27673923/8524403cd1991e9df42db7daabad5a93511f348e.png[/img]

[h1][B]Potential Abilities and Extraction[/B][/h1]
[LIST]
[*]In the Costume Gallery system, you will be able to add Potential Abilities, or stats, to your Costume, by clicking on the Fabric icon in the Ability section.
[*]Ability slots are ranked 1 - 5 with the first slot being Rank 1, and the last slot being Rank 5.
[*]To unlock Ability slots, you will need to use Fabrics, which can be gained through Costume Extraction, by right clicking a Costume in your Inventory and clicking the Extract button in the Costume Registration and Extraction section of your Costume Gallery UI.
[*]Keep in mind that Clan, timed, or opposite gender Costumes cannot be entered for Extraction.
[/LIST]
[h1][B]Fabric Cost for Potential Ability Ranks[/B][/h1]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27673923/1ff2cd0c369debf89d6c5699dd0aba8b39b2b55e.png[/img]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27673923/826188f57be3aeace6ec18fd8e6e053dfa0bf703.png[/img]

The long wait is over, and the Hero Band System Renewal is here! After creating your new Hero Band, the new Hero Band system can be accessed via F11!

[/LIST]

[h1][B]Hero Band Information[/B][/h1]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27673923/850b1d51b25961630e73702d53331e06fad497ed.png[/img]
[LIST]
[*]Hero Band Rank can be increased by grinding or by completing specific quests.
[/LIST]

[h1][B]Hero Band Attributes[/B][/h1]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27673923/4b559cc76e5bc7ed365d8906b7ce7e558becec5d.png[/img]
[LIST]
[*]Hero Band Attributes will be applied to all members of the band.
[*]Rank Attributes - Attribute points can be gained by increasing the Hero Band Rank. (up to 210 points total)

[*]Hero Band Emblem will be updated in the near future.
[/LIST]

notes.title: Potala Palace
notes.notes:
Unlock the secrets of the impenetrable Potala Palace.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27673923/6ca1ac386a78069c96e83d5d3dfa7030f88de142.png[/img]

After much anticipation, we will finally be opening Potala Palace to the public. Located in Tibet, you can also reach Potala Palace via Courier’s Guild Pass.

The Garden of Potala Palace can now be entered where many foes lie in wait for intruders.

[B]Potala Fortress[/B]
This is the premier dungeon for Potala Palace. Purple Protection Order are the dungeon passes  that drop from mobs in the Potala Palace Garden, as well as in the Potala Fortress Dungeon.

Unbreakable Body Epithet can be acquired by defeating the boss in Potala Fortress Purple Dungeon.

[B]La Zhuo Disguised as Beggar[/B]

At this NPC, you will be able to purchase, resource, and craft, materials and powerful accessories and new Blood Sorcerer Weapons with items dropped from the Potala Fortress Dungeon.

[B]Resource List[/B]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27673923/5f56147c28b879f2ab06b10d069562526e00c148.png[/img]

notes.title: Event: Accumulated Log-in Rewards
notes.notes:
This system will be replacing our previous Daily Attendance Rewards.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27673923/5e97358ced2316382c0ec1886ef02bb432e78eaa.png[/img]

Unlike the old system, in the Accumulated Log-in system, you will be rewarded for the amount of time you spend in-game.

Each day you log in, make sure to click your “Stamp Tracker” icon locate below the mini map in the game to receive your reward. The more time you are logged in, the more rewards you receive! Login rewards can only be claimed once per account. Be sure to claim the rewards on the character you are playing as some items are binds when received. Daily login resets at 12 AM.

[B]Daily Rewards

notes.title: Infinite Dungeon
notes.notes:
The Infinite Dungeon UI can be accessed by clicking the Infinite Dungeon Tab after pressing the F11 key.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27673923/ac56d9fcd508a19374a33319aa1088df955a49f4.png[/img]

This Dungeon, which can be entered individually, or in a party, is composed of 50 Ranks (stages) which increase in difficulty as you progress. After each rank you will receive Challenge Points in which you can exchange for exclusive Infinite Dungeon Items at the NPC Man Sangja which is located in the Infinite Dungeon Waiting Area.

[B]Entrance[/B]
[LIST]
[*]The Infinite Dungeon is accessible to all characters level 37 and above.
[/LIST]
[LIST]
[*]Before entering the Infinite Dungeon, you will have to enter the Waiting Area by pressing the Waiting Area button. This button can also be used to go back to Golden Castle in Loulan.
[/LIST]
[LIST]
[*]Once in the Waiting Area, you will be able to enter the Infinite Dungeon by pressing the (Enter the Infinite Dungeon button).
[/LIST]
[B]Daily Entries[/B]
[LIST]
[*]The number of daily entries to the Infinite Dungeon is limited to 5 entries, which resets at 00:00 server time.
[/LIST]
[LIST]
[*]The number of daily entries remaining is displayed in the “My Entries” section of the Infinite Dungeon UI above your accumulated Challenge Points.
[/LIST]
[LIST]
[*]Up to 5 additional daily entries can be added by using Infinite Stones which can be purchased in our Marketplace. (UI will pop up to enter the Marketplace upon pressing the Enter the Infinite Dungeon button when no entries are left.)
[/LIST]
[B]Ranking System[/B]

Ranking is determined by the clear time of all 50 Ranks in the Dungeon, and the number of Ranks cleared.

[B]How to View Ranking[/B]
[LIST]
[*]You can select between each server or all servers by clicking on the left  or right arrow button.
[/LIST]
[LIST]
[*]Select either Individual or Party and click the Refresh Button to pull up all rankings for the selected servers.
[/LIST]
[LIST]
[*]Party Ranking is displayed by Party Leader.
[/LIST]
[LIST]
[*]Party member info can be accessed by pressing the “Party” button in the Character Column.
[/LIST]
[LIST]
[*]Your personal Rank will be displayed under the green line of the Ranking List.
[/LIST]
[B]Ranking Columns[/B]
[LIST]
[*]Ranking - Your Ranking amongst other players and parties.
[/LIST]
[LIST]
[*]Duty - The Role of Individual or Party Leader
[/LIST]
[LIST]
[*]Character - Character name of Individual or Party Leader
[LIST]
[*]Party member info can be accessed by clicking the party button in the character column.
[/LIST]
[/LIST]
[LIST]
[*]Rank - Number of stages cleared individually or in a party.
[/LIST]
[LIST]
[*]Process Time - Time accumulated for clear or partial clear of Infinite Dungeon.
[/LIST]
[B]Party Information[/B]
[LIST]
[*]In this section of the UI, you can view your current party(Including your character), the number of entries each member has, and their location in the land.
[/LIST]
[LIST]
[*]All members must be in the waiting area in order to enter the Infinite Dungeon, in which case, all party member information will be displayed in green text.
[/LIST]
[LIST]
[*]If a member of your party is not in the waiting area, their information will be displayed in red text.
[/LIST]

[B]Notes:[/B]
[LIST]
[*]Additional images regarding the Infinite Dungeon will be added on the day of maintenance.
[*]Current text regarding items and UI names are subject to change on the day of maintenance.
[*]Materials for Create list will be consumed if failed.
[*]Infinite Dungeon Ranking will be reset on the last week of each month during maintenance period.
[*]Ranking Points will be distributed prior to reset periods.
[/LIST]

For more details, please visit the following [url=http://forums.playredfox.com/index.php?threads/infinite-dungeon.37781/] Link[/url]

notes.title: Master & Disciple System Renewal
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27673923/c37bb1d547125e780e705ec4ad3ee7a5ffdfc03b.png[/img]
The new Master & Disciple system can be accessed by clicking the Pupil tab after pressing the F11 key.

[B]Master and Disciple Conditions[/B]
[LIST]
[*]Master and Disciple relationships can only be formed within the same Clan. This means that if you are in the League of Beggars, you can only form  a Master and Disciple relationship with other Beggars, Shaolin, or Wu-Tang.
[/LIST]
[LIST]
[*]Characters can become a Master by completing the Master and Disciple quest line in Hefei, which is available after reaching Heaven’s Gate 5(Level 221).
[/LIST]
[LIST]
[*]Any characters that are Heaven’s Gate 3(Level 219) or lower can search and request discipleship to any Registered Masters by using the Search Master feature.
[/LIST]
Note: Vagabonds cannot become Master or Disciple.


[B]Searching for Masters and Disciples[/B]
[LIST]
[*]New Masters, and characters that meet the Disciple requirements can register themselves to be searchable by pressing the Register button.
[/LIST]
[LIST]
[*]Masters can search for Disciples by clicking the View Disciple button and clicking Search.
[/LIST]
[LIST]
[*]Disciples can search for Masters by clicking the View Master button and clicking Search.
[/LIST]
[LIST]
[*]You can also search for a specific Master or Disciple by entering a character name in the search bar and clicking the Search button.
[/LIST]
[B]Requests and Registration Info[/B]
[LIST]
[*]You can view the character info of those you have requested Discipleship or Mastership from by clicking on the Requested Button.
[/LIST]
[LIST]
[*]You can view character info of those requesting Discipleship or Mastership from you by clicking on the Received button.
[/LIST]
[LIST]
[*]Masters can view info of both Requested and Registered Disciples.
[/LIST]
[B]Master and Disciple Gifts[/B]
[LIST]
[*]Master’s Gifts can be given once daily, by clicking the Master’s Gift, which is received by both Master and Disciple.
[/LIST]
[LIST]
[*]Disciples can receive the Master’s Gift by clicking the Receive Gift button.
[/LIST]
[LIST]
[*]Rewards are also given when a disciple officially leaves the Discipleship by clicking the Graduate button, which will appear upon reaching Heaven’s Gate 4(Level 220).
[/LIST]
[LIST]
[*]The value of the gifts received, depends on the number of disciples which have received gifts on the previous day.
[/LIST]
[LIST]
[*]Master and Disciple Gifts can be received in the Event Window, by clicking on the gift box icon on the right of your screen, or pressing the H key.
[/LIST]
Note: Rewards will not be granted if a disciple leaves the Discipleship voluntarily before reaching Heaven’s Gate 4.


[B]Other Functions[/B]
[LIST]
[*]Disciples can call for help from their Master by clicking the Call Master Button.
[/LIST]
[LIST]
[*]Masters can teleport to their Disciples by highlighting the Disciple’s name and clicking the Visit Disciple button.
[/LIST]
[LIST]
[*]Characters in Discipleship can invite each other to a party by clicking the Invitation button.
[/LIST]
[LIST]
[*]M&D Chat can be used to chat with all members of the Discipleship.
[/LIST]
[LIST]
[*]Pigeongrams and Whispers can be sent to all members of the Discipleship.
[/LIST]
[LIST]
[*]Notices can be posted by a Master in the Master and Disciple window by clicking the Notice button.
[/LIST]

Additional Notes:
-The old systems will no longer be available.
-All previous Master and Disciple data will be reset.

For further details please visit the following link.

[url=http://forums.playredfox.com/index.php?threads/master-disciple-system-renewal.36754/]http://forums.playredfox.com/index.php?threads/master-disciple-system-renewal.36754/[/url]

notes.title: Regarding the Master and Disciple System
notes.notes:
Hello Dragons,

There will be an overhaul of the current Master and Disciple system. This update is scheduled to be released on July 11, 2017. In preparation for this change, we have temporarily disabled the Master and Disciple request option in the character menu UI. With the overhaul, all current Master and Disciple data will be reset. 

Additionally, we have been working with JoongWon Games to bring you as many events as we can. The recent Hero Tournament event may be small, but it is just one of many to come. There will also be a Summer Event later this month, that we hope you’ll enjoy. Check back on our forums for new announcements in the near future!

Thank you.

notes.title: Contest: Hero Tournament Photography
notes.notes:
Calling all photographers! We are looking for people to get the best in-game screenshots of our Hero Tournament. You will have to enter, of course. Your work amongst the battlefield will be eligible for great rewards.

[h1]HERES HOW IT WORKS:[/h1]

In order to enter, you must be participating in the next Hero Tournament, which will run on Saturday, the 27th, and Sunday, the 28th. During these times, try to take the best screenshot of the tournament while in battle yourself.

[B]PRIZES:[/B]

All participating players will receive a (TBA).
[LIST=1]
[*]1st TBA
[*]2nd TBA
[*]3rd TBA
[/LIST]

[B]RULES AND STUFF:[/B]
[LIST]
[*]Contest begins May 29, 2017, and ends at 6 PM PST June 12, 2018. Prizes will be awarded one week later.
[*]Screenshots may be edited.
[*]Player must be participating in the upcoming Hero Tournament.
[*]Prizes will be granted as-is; no substitutes will be offered.
[*]All contest decisions are at the discretion of Red Fox Games and are final.
[/LIST]


[h1]SUBMISSIONS:[/h1]
[LIST]
[*]Entries must be posted in the announcements section of our main website's forum in the thread, titled, [url=http://forums.playredfox.com/index.php?threads/contest-hero-tournament-photography.35380/]"Contest: Hero Tournament Photography".[/url]
[*]Entries posted elsewhere will NOT COUNT.
[/LIST]

notes.title: Event: Hero Tournament
notes.notes:
Come one, come all, for a chance to exhibit your skills in the art of combat! Join us in our first Hero Tournament in Nine Dragons Awaken history! Be prepared to be engaged in mortal combat.

[h1]Here’s how it works:[/h1]
Every Saturday and Sunday during the event duration, players will have a chance to participate in our Hero Tournament, for a chance to win some great prizes. This will be a level-ranged, free-for-all tournament, where the player with the most kills at the end will win it all. In the case that there is a tie, the prize will go to the player with the least amount of deaths.

For more details, please visit the following [url=http://forums.playredfox.com/index.php?threads/event-heroes-tournament.35127/#post-309394]link.[/url]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27673923/d2ec088e396506a6caa44718dfbe33fa67119ee5.png[/img]

notes.title: Refinement Level Expansion
notes.notes:
Hello Nine Dragons Community,

In this update we will be expanding on the max refine level for  weapons.
[LIST]
[*]Refinement levels 16 ~ 18 have been added for weapons.
[*]Refinement levels 19 and 20 can be achieved via Extreme Refinement Scroll.
[*]A decrease in refinement level is possible upon failure to refine for weapons level 16 and above.
[*]All refinement rate increase (Epithet, Buff, Tenderstone, Masteries, etc) only apply to levels 15 and below.
[*]High chance to acquire Red Stone (Excellence) from disassembling weapons with high refine levels.
[*]Refine features for levels 15 and below will remain the same.
[/LIST]
[B]Create List for New Materials[/B]
[LIST]
[*]Create Function has been added to NPC Mo Tailan in Hefei.
[/LIST]
[B]
New Refinement Material Details[/B]
[LIST]
[*]Refinement level 16 can be achieved with the material Pot of 16th Forgotten Soul.
[*]Refinement level 17 can be achieved with the material Pot of 17th Forgotten Soul.
[*]Refinement level 18 can be achieved with the material Pot of 18th Forgotten Soul.
[/LIST]
[B]
Items Required to Create Refinement Materials
[/B]
[LIST]
[*]New refinement materials can be created from Red Stone (Excellence)
[/LIST]
[B]
New Refinement Level Effects
[/B]
[LIST]
[*]New visual effects added for refinement levels 18 ~ 20.
[/LIST]
[B]
New Confirmation UI
[/B]
[LIST]
[*]Confirmation UI will appear when refining a weapon not protected by a dragon scale.
[/LIST]

For more details on the Refinement Level Expansion, please follow the url below.

http://forums.playredfox.com/index.php?threads/refinement-level-expansion.34073/#post-296579

notes.title: Event: 1st Year Anniversary Celebration
notes.notes:
It's 9Dragons's 1st Anniversary with RedFox Games!

Thank you for supporting us through all our good and hard times! We couldn't have made it this far without all our loyal players! In celebration, we will have some special events coming up to share with you all!

Be sure to keep your eye on this post for more details in the next few weeks!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27673923/7a99c0c5fa89c3efa59e2eb3c562e4e5574e9268.png[/img]

[h1]Event 1: 1st Year Anniversary Attendance Rewards[/h1]
Each day you log in, make sure to click your “Stamp Tracker” icon locate below the mini map in the game to receive your reward. The more days you log in, the more rewards you receive! Login rewards can only be claimed once per account. Be sure to claim the rewards on the character you are playing as some items are binds when received. Daily login resets at 12 AM.

These items will be sent to your "Web Inventory" in the Purchase Inventory.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27673923/e1b51c7a71e39c80f4b33b2c9f87cfe292117660.png[/img]

notes.title: 9Dragons Now on Steam!
notes.notes:

When registering for a RedFox Games account, please enter an email address that you want to use as your Account ID. You cannot under any circumstances change the email address associated with your RedFox account once it has been created.

notes.title: New Server - Yin Opening Soon!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We are excited to be the bearers of this exciting news: a new server will be opening on February 14, 2017, after maintenance. The new server is completely segregated from the existing server -- players can not transfer there with previously existing characters and cannot transfer any type of wealth into the new server. All players will begin at level 0. 


[h1][b]Additional Changes:[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*][b]New Server Cash Shop[/b] - We are removing the Blue Dragon's Treasure Box, Four Guardians Box, and Four Deity Package from the cash shop. Players will not be able to purchase these items if they play on the new Yin server. These items will only be available on Tao server.
[*][b]New Server PvP Areas[/b] - Players can engage in combat (PvP) starting from Liaodong map. There will be no Anti-PK buff on the new Yin server.
[*][b]Anti-PK Cavity Press[/b] - We are removing the Anti-PK buff "Spirit of the Conqueror" from all the NPC on Tao server. The Anti-PK buff will only be attainable through the Portable Cavity Press

More information can be found here:
[url]http://forums.playredfox.com/index.php?threads/new-server-yin-opening-soon.31665/[/url]
